V1 crossed the double yellow line and contacted V2 on its front plane with its own front plane.
V1 was negotiating a left turn. The front plane of V1 hit the right plane of V2.

Vehicle one was traveling westbound in a two-way roadway, about to turn left at the intersection. Vehicle two was traveling northbound in the third-lane of a six-lane, two-way roadway, approaching an intersection. As vehicle one made its turn, the left side of vehicle one impacted the front of vehicle two.
V1 was northbound negotiating a curve approaching an intersection. V2 was westbound going straight.
Vehicle one was traveling on the roadway about to turn left at an intersection. As vehicle one made its turn, the front of vehicle one impacted the right side of vehicle two.
V1 merged right and contacted V2.

Vehicle one was traveling westbound in the lane one approaching an intersection. Vehicle two was traveling southbound about to turn right at the same intersection. The left of vehicle two impacted the front of vehicle one.
V1 was negotiating a left turn. V2 was approaching an intersection. The front plane of V1 hit the front plane of V2.
V1 was eastbound in the number two lane of a four lane roadway approaching an intersection about to make a left. V2 was westbound in the number two lane of a four-lane roadway going straight.
V1 was eastbound negotiating a left turn. V2 was westbound approaching an intersection. The front plane of V2 hit the front plane of V1.
Vehicle one was traveling in the second-lane of a two-way roadway, about to turn left at an intersection. Vehicle two was traveling in the second-lane of a two-way roadway.
Vehicle one veered into Vehicle two's lane and the front of vehicle one impacted the front of vehicle two.

Vehicle one was traveling westbound in the left turn lane of a seven-lane, two-way roadway. Vehicle two was traveling eastbound in the third-lane of the same roadway. As vehicle one turned left at the intersection, the front struck the front of vehicle two.
V1 was in the number three-left turn lane making a left turn. V2 was in the number two lane going straight. V1's right plane was contacted by V2's front plane.
V1 was negotiating a left turn. V2 was approaching the same intersection. The front plane of V1 hit the front plane of V2.

V1 was westbound in the number three lane of a four lane highway going straight. V2 was westbound in the number two lane going straight on the same highway. After changing to lane two V1's front plane contacted V2's rear plane.

V1 was traveling eastbound on a straight roadway when the driver turned on the left turn signal to make a left hand turn. V1 started to turn left and made a U turn to travel south instead of north and came back across the intersection and the front left of V2 struck the right front of V1. V1 was facing east at final rest on the roadway. V2 was traveling behind V1 eastbound on the same straight roadway and saw V1 signal to turn left. V2 started to pass on the right side and the front left struck the right front of V1.

V1 was traveling eastbound on a 5 lane urban straight road and turned into the middle turn lane intending to turn left. An unknown vehicle stopped in the #2 lane so V1 could turn left. V1 turned left and the front struck the left side of V2 in the #1 lane. V1 came to final rest in the #1 west bound lane facing in a northern direction on its wheels. V2 was traveling west bound in the #1 lane, on the 5 lane urban straight road when the left side was struck by the front of V1. V2 at POI rotated in a counterclockwise direction.

Vehicle one was traveling eastbound on a rural, two-lane roadway. V2 was traveling westbound on the same roadway. V1 crossed the centerline. The front of V1 struck the front of V2. V1 rotated clockwise, V2 rotated counterclockwise and the left side of V1 was struck by the front of V2. V1 departed the south side of the roadway.

V1 was traveling north in the #1 lane of a 3-lane roadway, approaching a traffic signal controlled intersection. V2 was southbound in the #5 lane of the same roadway and was executing a U-Turn. The right side of V1 and back trailer hitch of V2 collided.

V1 crossed left of the centerline into the eastbound lane of traffic. V2 was eastbound on the same roadway. V1 and V2 collided head-on in the eastbound lane. V1 rotated clockwise and pushed V2 backward. V2 rotated counterclockwise.
V1 traveled out into the 5 lane roadway, turning left and the front struck V2 in the front right.

V1 was westbound in a left turn lane entering an intersection. V2 was eastbound entering the intersection. V1 turned across the path of V2 and the vehicles collided front-to-front in the intersection.

This is a two vehicle crash involving a passenger vehicle and a medium/heavy commercial vehicle. V1 was eastbound on a rural, 4-lane, undivided, bituminous roadway with no traffic controls. V2 was ahead of V1 on the same rural roadway, slowing and attempting to make a right turn into a dirt field road. The driver of V1 was changing lanes from the #2 back into the #1 lane, and didn't realize V2 was slowing and turning. The driver of V1 attempted to avoid by steering left at nearly the point of impact. The right front collided with the left rearmost trailer of V2. This was a underride situation and V1 went under the bed level of the 2nd trailer causing severe damage and intrusion to V1. Immediately after impact V1 began a rapid clockwise rotation; the left side tires/wheels tripped on the roadway and the vehicle overturned a total of 2 quarter turns.

V1 was traveling east bound on an urban roadway approaching an intersection with a stop sign. V2 was traveling south bound in the #1 lane approaching the same intersection. V1 stopped at the stop sign and pulled out across the southbound roadway to make a left hand turn to travel north. V2 moved into the #2 southbound lane to pass slow traffic. The left side of V1 was struck by the front of V2.

V1 was westbound in lane 1 of an urban roadway, approaching an intersection controlled by traffic signals. V2 was westbound in lane 1 on the same urban roadway in front of V1. V2 was stopped for traffic ahead. V1 struck the rear of V2 and came to rest partially in lane 2 and partially in lane 3. V2 remained at the point of contact.
V1 was traveling westbound in the #3 lane on a 3-lane, straight urban roadway approaching a traffic-controlled intersection. The front of V1 and the back of V2 collided.
V1 crossed into the westbound lane, where it was struck by the front of V2.

V1's left side was impacted by the front of V2. V1 continued across the intersection with the left front tire locked, skidding counter clockwise, coming to rest at about 20 degrees west of its original direction of travel, facing generally north, in the original lane of travel. The driver of V2 attempted full-lock braking and the front struck V1 in the left side, causing deployment of both front-seat airbags. V2 then rotated counter clockwise and came to rest at about the centerline of the roadway.

V1 was traveling west bound on a 2 lane urban straight roadway approaching an intersection controlled by a stop sign. V1 stopped at the stop sign and was going to turn right to travel north. V1 driver hit the gas instead of the brake and went out into the intersection trying to steer right, and the front of V1 struck the front of V2. V1 bounced off V2 and continued northwesterly and up over the curb and sidewalk and the front struck a power pole. V2 was traveling south on a 3 lane straight urban roadway approaching an intersection. V2 front right bumper impacted the front of V1.
V1 entered the intersection and attempted to make a left turn into the path of V2. The front of V1 struck the left rear tire and wheel of V2.
V1 was going straight through the intersection. V2 attempted to complete the left turn and was struck in the right side by the front of V1.

V1 proceeded into the intersection and braked upon noticing V2 entering the intersection from the cross street. V1 continued at full-lock braking, without rotation, its front striking V2 in the left side and rotating counter-clockwise. V1 came to final rest in the opposite lane of travel, still facing west. V2 rotated clockwise and came to rest on the sidewalk facing north-northeast.

V1 was traveling south on a 5 lane, straight urban roadway in the middle turn lane for each direction and V1 was turning left. V1 turned left and the right side was struck by the front of V2. V1 final rest was on its wheels in the #1 lane of travel facing east. V2 was northbound on a 5 lane, level, straight, urban roadway in the #2 lane when the front struck V1 in the right front.

V1 was exiting a private driveway at a shopping center, intending to turn left into the center two-way left-turn lane. It was struck on the left rear portion by V2. V1 then rotated counter clockwise between 30 and 40 degrees, to come to rest within the center two-way left-turn lane, facing north. No airbags deployed on V1. V2 was traveling south in the number 2 south-bound lane when V1 entered the roadway from a private drive to the right, crossing its direction of travel while turning left. Driver of V2 attempted braking, and the front left side of V2 struck V1 on the left. No airbags deployed in V2 as it continued forward for a very short distance, and came to rest within its original lane of travel.

V1 entered the intersection and attempted to make a left turn across the path of V2. The front of V2 struck the left side of V1 at the LF tire & wheel. V1 and V2 remained in contact and both rotated counterclockwise to the northwest corner of the intersection where they came to final rest.

V1 was southbound in lane 2 of an urban five-lane, bituminous asphalt roadway. V2 was stopped in the southbound center turn lane of the same five-lane roadway. V1 crossed the left lane edge, striking V2 in the right rear, causing V2 to rotate counter-clockwise into the northbound lanes.

V1 was westbound in the first lane of a three-lane, two-way, undivided, asphalt roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was northbound in the first lane of a two-lane, two-way, undivided, asphalt roadway, approaching the same intersection. As both vehicles entered the intersection, the front of V2 impacted the left side of V1.

V1 was traveling northbound on a two lane, straight roadway approaching a vehicle turning left. V1 locked the brakes and turned left to avoid hitting the vehicle but when V1 traveled into the southbound lane V1's right side was struck by the front of V2.
V1 pulled out onto the east/west roadway to travel east and the left side was struck by the front of V2.

V1 was traveling east bound in the #3 lane on a 3 lane divided urban roadway when the front struck the back of V2. V2 was traveling on the same roadway ahead of V1 when the driver stopped for traffic and V1 struck the back of the vehicle.
V1 was traveling eastbound in the second lane of a four-lane, two-way roadway. V2 was stopped ahead of V1 in the same lane. The front of V1 impacted the back of V2.

A hit and run crash involving V1 and a commercial vehicle on a rural interstate roadway. V1 was eastbound on a straight, divided interstate roadway. A commercial motor vehicle struck V1 on the left side and caused V1 to depart the roadway on the right shoulder. V1 continued forward and struck a small tree with the front of the vehicle.
V1 was traveling on a straight roadway when traffic stopped suddenly. V1 locked the brakes and the front struck V2 in the back.

V1 was traveling eastbound on a 2 lane urban roadway approaching an intersection controlled by stop signs only for eastbound and westbound traffic. V2 was traveling south on a 2 lane urban roadway approaching the same intersection. V1 stopped at the stop sign and then entered the intersection to travel east and the left side was struck by the front of V2.

V1 was westbound on an urban roadway. V2 was eastbound on the same urban roadway in the opposite lane. One or both vehicles crossed the centerline and collided. The front of V2 struck the left side of V1.

V1 was traveling southbound in the first lane of a three-lane bituminous roadway, approaching slower traffic ahead. V2 was southbound ahead of V1 in the same lane. The front of V1 impacted the back of V2.

V2 stopped before the crosswalk at an intersection for a non-contact vehicle. V1's front impacted the left rear bumper of V2. V2 was then pushed a few meters ahead remaining in V2's lane of travel. V2 then pulled onto a nearby intersecting roadway. V1 was behind and to the left of V2 partially into the center turn lane at final rest.
V1 was in the left turn lane and turning left at the intersection and the right side was struck by the front right of V2.

V1 was traveling eastbound on a five-lane urban roadway in the third (two-way left-turn) lane approaching an intersection to turn left. As V1 made its turn, the front of V1 impacted the front of V2. V1 at POI was pushed to the northwest corner of the intersection facing northwest at final rest on its wheels. V2 was traveling westbound on a five-lane roadway approaching an intersection. V2 front struck the front right of V1 and final rest was in the westbound #1 lane facing northwest on its wheels.
V2 stopped in the roadway in the 2nd EB lane. V1 was EB in the same lane as V2, approached V2 and attempted to steer right and brake to avoid V2. The front of V1 impacted the back right of V2.

V1 was traveling eastbound in the first lane of a two-lane, divided roadway. V2 was eastbound behind V1 in the same lane, traveling with higher speed than V1. The front of V2 impacted the back of V1. V1 rotated clockwise from impact and departed the roadway to the right, coming to rest off the road, facing generally southeast. V2 continued forward after the crash and came to a controlled stop on the right shoulder area. Both vehicles were towed due to damage. The driver of V1 was hospitalized with neck and upper back fractures.
V1 was westbound on a dry, rural, level two-lane roadway. V2 was in front of V1 on the same roadway. The front of V1 struck the back of V2.

This was a 2-vehicle intersection collision. V1 approached the stop sign, stopped and attempted to make a left turn across the path of V2. The front of V2 struck the left side of V1 on the driver's door and B-pillar area. V1 and V2 rotated after impact. V1 came to a final rest on the pavement north of the centerline and east of the intersection facing generally northbound. V2 was facing generally northwest at final rest.

This crash involves two vehicles, same roadway, opposite directions, that collide in an intersection. V1 was eastbound on an intersection controlled by operating traffic signals. V2 was westbound on the same roadway in the designated left turn lane and attempted to make a left turn in front of oncoming V1. The unrestrained driver of V1 attempted to avoid the crash by hard braking and lockup. The attempt was unsuccessful and the front of V1 struck the right side of V2. V1 continued forward while rotating clockwise and came to final rest within the intersection facing generally southeast. V2 rotated clockwise at impact and came to final rest within the intersection facing generally northwest.

V1 was southbound in the first lane of a two-lane, bituminous roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was westbound in the first lane of the intersecting three-lane, bituminous roadway. As both vehicles entered the intersection, the front of V2 impacted the left side of V1, causing both vehicles to rotate towards each other and a second sideslap impact occurred between the left side of V1 and the right side of V2.

V1 was exiting from a commercial driveway, crossing over an urban, 5 lane (center turn lane), divided roadway intending to turn eastbound. V2 was westbound on the urban, 5 lane (center turn lane), divided roadway going straight. As V1 entered the westbound roadway, V2 braked and changed lanes from the #2 to #1 westbound lane attempting to avoid V1. V1's right impacted V2's front and V1 rotated counterclockwise coming to final rest on the center divider facing westbound. V2 continued forward stopping on the roadway facing west.

V1 was southbound on a divided roadway at an intersection attempting to make a left turn. V2 was northbound on the same road in the #2 lane entering the intersection. V1 turned left in front of V2 and they collided front to front.

V1 was westbound on a 2 lane, urban, dry, level, bituminous roadway with a slight curve to the right. V1 approached V2 traveling in the same direction, at a slower speed, close to the north edge of the roadway. The front of V1 impacted the rear of V2.
V1 was eastbound in the first lane of a five-lane, two-way roadway. V2 was stopped in the same lane, ahead of V1. The front of V1 impacted the back of V2.
V1, a Saturn SL Sedan, was northbound turning left (west) as V2 also entered the intersection southbound in the #1 lane. V1 and V2 collided front to front in the southbound #1 lane.

V1 was northbound on an urban, 2-lane roadway controlled by a stop sign at the intersection with another 2-lane roadway. V2 was westbound on the intersecting urban, 2-lane roadway with no traffic controls present. V1 entered the intersection and the front struck the left side of V2.

V1 was stopped at a stop sign at an intersection to make a left lane turn. V2 was traveling northbound approaching the same intersection. V1 pulled out and the left side of V1 was struck by the front of V2. After impact, the right side of V2 and the left side of V1 side-slapped. V1 went right and into a clockwise rotation and stopped facing in a northeasterly direction at final rest. V1 traveled to the Northwest side and off the roadway. V2 final rest was facing north.
V1 was westbound and V2 was southbound. Both vehicles entered the intersection and the front of V1 impacted the left side of V2 from the B pillar to the rear bumper.

V1 was eastbound on an urban, divided roadway in the left turn lane at an intersection controlled by operating traffic signals. V2 was westbound from the opposite direction on the same roadway entering the same intersection in the #1 lane.  V1 entered the intersection and attempted to make a left turn across the path of westbound V2. The front of V2 struck the right side of V1 which caused V1 to abruptly rotate counterclockwise. V2 rotated clockwise. Vehicle 1's right and vehicle 2's left sideslapped. Vehicle 2 continued forward.

V1 was traveling north on a 6 lane, dry, level, straight, Bituminous, urban roadway approaching an intersection. V2 was traveling north bound on the same dry, level, straight, bituminous, urban roadway approaching the intersection in the left turn lane. V2 entered the intersection and waited for traffic to clear to turn left. V2 turned left and the front was struck by the front of V1.

A two-vehicle crash occurred within the intersection of two three-lane roadways. Vehicle one was westbound approaching the intersection. Vehicle two was southbound approaching the intersection. The front of the Dodge impacted the left rear of the Chevrolet.

V1 was making a left turn from a lane marked with traffic signs prohibiting a left turn. V2 entered the intersection, attempted to avoid a collision by braking and struck the right side of V1 with the front of V2. V1 and V2 rotated slightly clockwise and came to rest near the area of impact.

V1, was southbound in the designated turn lane of an intersection controlled by traffic signals. V2, was northbound on the same urban roadway. The driver of V1 attempted to make a left turn across the path of northbound V2 and they collided, front to front within the intersection.

V1, a station wagon was in a designated right turn lane approaching an intersection controlled by operating overhead traffic signals. V2, a van, was in the #2 lane of the intersecting roadway also controlled by operating overhead traffic signals. V1 entered the intersection, saw V2, attempted to avoid by steering left and then braking hard with lockup. V1 skidded and collided with the left side of V2 with the right front corner.

two-vehicle crash occurred in the intersection of a two-lane and a three-lane roadway. The two-lane road is controlled by a stop sign. The three-lane road has one through lane in either direction and a left turn only lane at the intersection. Vehicle one was southbound on the two-lane road. Vehicle two was eastbound on the three-lane road. The front of the Chevrolet impacted the right side of the Jeep. The Chevrolet and the Jeep side slapped, the left side of the Chevrolet to the right side of the Jeep. The Jeep came off the side slap and tripped and rolled one-quarter turn onto its left side. Both vehicles came to rest in the southeast corner of the intersection.

Vehicle one was eastbound on a five-lane roadway approaching an intersection. Vehicle two was in lane one of the same roadway. As vehicle one turned left at the intersection, the front struck the front of vehicle two.
V1 was traveling westbound and went to the right over the solid white fog line, striking the back of a parked pick-up truck in the emergency lane.
V1 making a left turn in front of V2; front of V2 struck the left driver door of V1.

V1 was northbound on a rural, dry, straight, level, bituminous, two-lane roadway. V2 was southbound on the same roadway. V1 traveled off the right side of the roadway, back on to the roadway and then into the southbound lane. The front of V1 struck the front of V2.

V1 was northbound on a divided roadway entering an intersection controlled by traffic signals. V2 was also northbound on the same urban roadway. V1 was originally behind V3 and changed lanes to pass. V1 then saw the slower V2 vehicle, applied hard braking and struck the rear of V2 with its front. The impact caused V2 to rotate and its left front corner struck V3.

This is a severe crash involving 2 CDS vehicles in transport and a non-CDS heavy truck. V1 had previously struck the back of a medium-heavy truck in a severe dust storm. V1 and the 2 restrained occupants inside were still sitting on the roadway in the #1 lane from this crash when the 1st event occurred. V3 was westbound on a rural 2-lane roadway, saw the disabled V1 ahead in the same #1 lane, attempted to steer left but struck the left rear of V1 with the tractor's right front. The impact propelled V1 forward. V2, also westbound on the same roadway, entered the dust storm and collided with the back of V1 propelling it even further forward.

V1 was traveling southbound on a straight, level, dry, rural, 2 lane bituminous roadway approaching an intersection. V2 was westbound on a 2 lane rural, dry, level, straight, bituminous roadway approaching the same intersection intending to turn left. V2's approach was controlled by a stop sign. V1 and V2 entered the intersection at the same time and the front left of V1 struck V2 in the right side. V1 and V2 then struck again for event #2, a side slap contact. V1 then went off the right side of the roadway and came to final rest in the dirt/sand. V2 at POI rotated in a counterclockwise direction and went across the northbound lanes and off the roadway to the east. V2 then continued back in a northern direction, ran over an A-frame sign, and struck a telephone pole with the front.

V1 was stopped at a stop sign at an intersection facing north on a two-lane urban roadway. V2 was traveling eastbound approaching the same intersection. V1 entered the intersection attempting to turn left. V2 entered the intersection attempting to go straight. The front of V2 impacted the left of V1.

Vehicle one entered the intersection and collided with the front of vehicle two. The Honda then veered to the southeast over the curb, impacted a brick wall, and continued down the sidewalk to final rest. Both front airbags of the Honda deployed. The Ford and the Honda collided in the T-intersection. The Ford's final rest was immediately east of the point of impact. The drivers front airbag of the Ford deployed.

V1 was traveling northbound on a roadway approaching a T intersection. V2 was traveling eastbound on a roadway approaching the same T intersection. V1 pulled out to see if it was clear to turn left and was struck by the front of V2. V1 rotated in a clockwise direction then the left of V1 and the right of V2 side-slapped.

V1 was stopped facing westbound on an urban entrance to a parking lot. V2 was traveling northbound in the #2 lane on a 5 lane urban roadway approaching the same entrance. V1 pulled out into the roadway to turn left and travel south and was struck in the left side by the front of V2.

Vehicle one was southbound in lane two approaching an intersection. Vehicle two was eastbound in lane two approaching the same intersection. V1 entered the intersection intending to go straight. V2 entered the intersection intending to turn left. The front of V1 impacted the left side of vehicle two.

This is a 2 vehicle intersection related crash where one vehicle turns across the path of another and they collide. V1 was eastbound in the #1 lane of an urban, 2-lane divided roadway entering an intersection controlled by an operating traffic signal. V2 was northbound in the #1 lane of the intersecting urban, 2-lane roadway. V2 entered the intersection and attempted to make a left turn across the path of eastbound V1 and they collided front-to-front.
V1 was traveling south bound in the #1 lane. V2 was stopped in the #1 lane for traffic and the front of V1 stuck the back of V2.

V1 was stopped at a stop-sign controlled intersection attempting to travel west across traffic. V2 was traveling northbound approaching the intersection. In the intersection the left front fender/wheel of V1 impacted the front of V2. The left side of V1 and the right side of V2 side-slapped.

V1 was traveling eastbound on a 2 lane divided roadway approaching an intersection. V2 was traveling northbound on a 5 lane roadway approaching the same intersection. V1 approached the intersection and was going to turn right to travel south. V2 was approaching the intersection in the southbound #2 lane as directed by the police. V1 turned right and turned wide into the #2 lane of travel and the front of V1 struck V2 in the front.
V1, a Cadillac Deville, struck the back of V2, a Honda Accord. V1 was driven from the point of impact for several blocks before being abandoned. The driver and passenger of V1 were never identified.

V1 was traveling southbound approaching an intersection. V2 was traveling westbound approaching the same intersection. V2 stopped and was turning left when the left side of V2 was struck by the front of V1.

V1 was traveling westbound on a straight rural roadway. V2 was traveling eastbound on the same roadway approaching the same intersection. V1 entered the left turn lane to travel south and when the driver entered the intersection the front was struck by the front of V2. V1 after POI started a counterclockwise rotation on the roadway and was facing west in the left turn lane at final rest. V2 at POI rotated and traveled southeast, and was facing southwesterly on the roadway shoulder.

V1 lost traction and started a counterclockwise rotation. V1 slid into the westbound lane and the right side struck the front of V2. V1 rotated after point of impact and was on its wheels on the shoulder at final rest facing west. V2 was traveling westbound when the front was struck by the right side of V1. V2 went off the right side of the roadway and was facing west at final rest on its wheels.

Vehicle one (V1) was traveling southbound in the first lane of a two-lane, two-way, undivided, bituminous roadway. V2 was traveling southbound in the same lane, ahead of V1. V1 applied brakes and began skidding longitudinally on the surface, and the front of V1 impacted the back of V2. V1 rotated slightly counter-clockwise from impact and came to rest on the roadside.

V1 was westbound approaching an intersection controlled by a stop sign. The driver of V1 started a left-turn from the stop sign. V2 was northbound in the number one lane. V2 changed from the number one to the number two lane and the front of V2 and left side of V1 collided.

Vehicle one (V1) was traveling northbound in the first lane of a two-lane, two-way, undivided, bituminous highway. Vehicle two (V2) was traveling southbound in the first lane of opposing traffic, coming around a leftward curve. V2 departed the roadway onto the right shoulder as it negotiated the curve. V2 corrected left, and crossed the center stripe into the northbound lane where the front of V2 impacted the front of V1.

V1 was traveling eastbound on a straight roadway. V2 was traveling eastbound behind V1 and attempted to pass V1. V1 was going to turn left into a parking area and was struck in the back by a trailer attached to a tractor. V2 locked up his brakes and turned right but the trailer stuck the back of V1.

V1 was southbound on a rural, dry, level, bituminous, 2-lane roadway with no traffic controls. V1 was attempting to pass a southbound tractor-trailer combination and the front struck the left side of an oncoming vehicle. V1 then traveled off the east edge of the roadway and into open desert terrain rotating counterclockwise. V2 was northbound on the same rural 2-lane roadway with no traffic controls. The driver of V2 was unable to affect any avoidance efforts when V1 attempted to pass the non-contact tractor-trailer, and was struck in the left side.

Vehicle one (V1) was traveling westbound in the first lane of a two-lane, positively divided, bituminous highway. Vehicle two (V2) was traveling westbound in the same lane, ahead of V1. V1 moved left to pass V2. While passing, V1 moved right, and the front of V1 impacted the left side of V2.

Vehicle one (V1) was traveling westbound in the first lane of a two-lane, two-way, undivided, bituminous roadway, approaching an intersection. Vehicle two (V2) was traveling northbound in the first lane of a two-lane, two-way, undivided, bituminous roadway, approaching the same intersection. As both vehicles entered the intersection, the front of V2 impacted the left side of V1. Both vehicles rotated counter-clockwise and came to rest in the intersection. Both vehicles were towed due to damage.

V1 was traveling westbound on a 5-lane, straight, level, urban, bituminous roadway. V2 was traveling westbound on the same roadway in the same travel lane in front of V1 and stopped for a recreational vehicle entering the roadway from a private drive. The front of V1 and back of V2 collided.

V1 was traveling northbound in the #1 lane on a 5 lane straight roadway approaching an intersection controlled by traffic signals. V2 was traveling westbound on a 3 lane straight roadway approaching an intersection controlled by a traffic signal. V1 and V2 entered the intersection and the front of V1 struck the left side of V2.

V1 was traveling westbound on a rural, 4 lane, bituminous roadway with a bike path approaching an intersection. V2 was traveling northbound on a 2 lane rural roadway approaching the same intersection, controlled with a stop sign and blinking red lights. V1 and V2 entered the intersection and the front of V1 struck the right side doors of V2. V1 pushed V2 to final rest on the northwest side of the intersection.

V1 was traveling northbound on a 2-Lane, level, slight curve left, bituminous, urban roadway. V2 was traveling southbound on the same two lane urban, level, slight curve right, bituminous roadway. The front of V1 struck the front of V2.

V1 was stopped at a stop-sign controlled intersection facing south. V1 was waiting for traffic to clear to turn left. V2 was traveling westbound approaching the same intersection. V1 entered the intersection and the left side of V1 was struck by the front of V2. V1 at POI rotated in a counterclockwise direction and the left front of V1 struck the front of V2 in a side slap.
V1 lost control, spun around and was facing west on the eastbound lane. The front of V2 struck the front of V1.

V1 was traveling westbound on a roadway when the driver saw a vehicle turning left. V2 was traveling westbound on the same roadway approaching a roadway to turn left. V2 started to turn left, crossed into the southbound lane but realized he was not close to the left turn and a tractor-trailer was traveling southbound. V2 crossed back into the westbound lane and stopped for traffic to clear, and the back was struck by the front of V1. V1 noticed the vehicle coming back into the westbound lane. V1 steered right, but the front struck the back of V2.
V1 was traveling westbound approaching the intersection in the #1 lane, and V2 was southbound in the #2 lane. The vehicles entered the intersection and the front of V1 struck the left side of V2.

V1 was traveling northbound. V2 was traveling southbound. V1 veered into the southbound lane and the front of V1 was struck by the front of V2. V2 rotated in a clockwise direction and the front of V1 impacted the right of V2.

V1 collided with the rear of V2, which was stopped at a green light as the driver was trying to shift into a forward gear. The impact with V1 pushed V2 forward into the intersection where it came to final rest facing generally east northeast. After impact V1 came to rest at an unknown location.

Vehicle one (V1) was traveling eastbound in the first lane of a two-lane, two-way, undivided highway. Vehicle two (V2) was traveling westbound in the first lane of opposing traffic. V1 departed its lane to the left, entering the westbound lane, where the front of V1 impacted the front of V2. V1 was pushed backward as it rotated counter-clockwise, and it came to rest facing west in the westbound lane. V2 deflected right and departed the road to the right side, coming to rest on the grass shoulder.

V1 had stopped at the stop sign heading north in the number 1 lane and entered the intersection to turn left. V2 entered the intersection in the number 2 eastbound lane and the front of V2 and left side of V1 collided.

V1 was traveling northbound on a freeway off ramp. V1 overtook a vehicle which was stopped at the traffic signal, crossed through the intersection, proceeded into the westbound lanes, and the front of V1 and front of V2 collided. V2 was stopped westbound in the number 2 lane when the crash occurred.

V1 was traveling westbound on a rural, straight, level, bituminous roadway approaching an intersection that is controlled by stop signs from the east and west directions only. V2 was travelling southbound on a straight, level, rural, bituminous roadway approaching the intersection. V1 and V2 entered the intersection and the right side of V1 and front of V2 collided.

V1 was traveling northbound in the left turn lane approaching an intersection. V2 was traveling southbound on the same roadway approaching the same intersection in the #2 lane. V1 and V2 entered the intersection at the same time and the front of V1 struck the front of V2.
V1 entered the intersection and the front of V1 and right side of V2 collided.

V1 was traveling eastbound on a straight roadway in the #3 lane. V2 was traveling eastbound on the same roadway in the #1 lane. V1 moved from lane 3 to lane 1 in an attempt to turn right into a private driveway, and the right side of V1 struck the front of V2.

V1 was traveling northbound on a roadway approaching an intersection. V2 was traveling eastbound on a roadway approaching the same intersection. Both vehicles entered the intersection and the front of V1 was struck by the right side of V2. V1 rotated clockwise, V2 rotated counterclockwise, and the left side of V1 impacted the right side of V2 in a side slap.
V1 lost control and rotated clockwise, left rear struck V2 in the left side.

V1 was traveling eastbound approaching an intersection in the left turn lane. V2 was traveling westbound approaching an intersection in the #2 lane. V1 turned left and the right of V1 and the front of V2 collided. V1 then rotated counterclockwise and V2 rotated clockwise, resulting in a sideslap between the right side of V1's rear bumper and the left side of V2 at the area between the left rear door and left rear axle. V1 came to rest facing generally north on the north side of the intersection. V2 came to rest in the middle of the intersection facing generally northeast.
V1 crossed over the centerline and the front struck the front of V2. After the frontal impact with V1, V2 rotated clockwise and came to rest in the northbound lane facing generally east.

V1 traveled northbound then stopped at the stop sign. V2 was eastbound in the number 2 lane following a second school bus. As the lead school bus slowed, entered the number 1 lane and began to turn right, V1 entered the intersection intending to turn left and at the same time, V2 entered the intersection intending to go straight. The left side of V1 and front of V2 collided and this impact caused V1 to rotate clockwise rapidly resulting in a sideslap between the left side of V1 and right side of V2. V1 continued to rotate clockwise and slid on an east/southeast trajectory to final rest of the south edge of the road to the east of the intersection facing generally south. After impact with V1, V2, which had braked and attempted to steer left to avoid the collision, rolled on a northeast trajectory, crossed the westbound lanes, and came to final rest off the north side of the road to the east of the intersection facing generally east.
V1 turned left and the right side of V1 was struck by the front of V2.

A pickup was traveling southbound on a rural, 2 lane, straight roadway following traffic. V1 steered left into the oncoming lane to pass, and the front of V1 and the back of V2 collided. V2 was traveling southbound on the same roadway and had slowed and started to turn left when the crash with V1 occurred. The collision caused V2 to rotate and depart the roadway, crossing an intersecting road and coming to rest off the north edge of the roadway. V1 stopped in the northbound lane and was moved to the west side of the roadway facing south after the accident.
V1 entered the intersection and the left side of V1 and the front of V2 collided.

V1 was traveling northbound on a 2 lane rural roadway approaching an intersection. V2 was traveling westbound on a 2 lane rural roadway approaching the same intersection. V1 and V2 entered the intersection intending to go straight and the front of V1 and the left side of V2 collided. The impact redirected V1 and caused V2 to enter a counterclockwise rotation. As V2 rotated, the two vehicles had minor front to front impacts followed by a V1 front to V2 rear impact. V1 and V2 came to final rest off the road to the northwest of the intersection. Both vehicles were towed due to damage.

This two vehicle crash occurred in a four-way rural intersection controlled by a stop sign for north and southbound traffic, and not controlled for east and westbound traffic. The north/south roadway is non-divided, straight, level and of bituminous construction and consists of one lane in each direction. The east/west roadway is five lanes, straight, level and of bituminous construction and consists of two lanes in each direction which are divided by a two way left turn lane. V1 was eastbound in the number one lane approaching the intersection intending to go straight. V2 was northbound approaching the intersection intending to go straight. As V1 approached the intersection the driver noticed V2 enter the intersection and applied his brakes and steered left but was unable to avoid the collision and the front of V1 and V2 left side rear wheels collided. After impact V1 rotated counterclockwise and came to rest partially in the number two eastbound lane and partially in the number one eastbound lane facing generally west/southwest. After impact with V1, V2 crossed the intersection and rotated clockwise approximately 150 degrees then came to final rest facing generally south/southwest.
V1 was passing a slower vehicle in the left lane. V2 was traveling in the opposite direction in the same lane. The front of V1 impacted the front of V2.

V1 was traveling on a two lane, rural, interstate roadway. V1 was in the #1 lane when the front struck the back of a parked, unoccupied Dept. of Transportation (DOT) truck equipped with large flashing light. V1 rotated in a clockwise direction and final rest was on its wheels facing south in the #2 eastbound lane of travel. The legally parked DOT vehicle was parked on the roadway in the #1 lane of travel with flashing arrow sign in the back of the truck. The unoccupied vehicle was struck in the back by the front of V1 and at POI went forward and off the north side of the roadway and into the median. The DOT vehicle was on its wheels at final rest facing in a northern direction.

This two vehicle crash occurred in a four way intersection. V1 was eastbound in the number one lane and entered the intersection intending to go straight. V2 was northbound in the number one lane and entered the intersection intending to go straight. The right side of V1 and front of V2 collided in the intersection, then both vehicles rotated and a side slap occurred between the right side of V1 and the left side of V2. After the second impact, V1 departed the roadway and had a front event with two power poles. V1 came to final rest against the poles. After the second impact with V1, V2 departed on a northeast trajectory and came to final rest on the north shoulder to the east of the intersection facing east.
V1 impacted V2.

V1 turned left into the intersection and the right side of V1 and the front of V2 collided. The left front bumper corner of V2 snagged on the right side lower 'C' pillar of V1; this snag caused both vehicles to enter clockwise rotations. After rotating approximately 180 degrees, V1 tripped over to the right and rolled 2 quarter-turns, then came to rest on the top plane. V2 rotated about 50 degrees, then came to rest on its wheels. V1 and V2 were towed due to damage.

V1 entered the roadway intending to go west and the front of V1 impacted the right side of V2, which was eastbound in the number one lane and, upon noticing V1, steered left and entered the number two lane. The impact rotated V1 clockwise and it came to a stop on the number one eastbound lane facing generally east. V2 came to a controlled stop in the two-way center turn lane.

V1 was traveling northbound in the left turn lane approaching an intersection. V2 was traveling southbound in the #1 lane approaching the same intersection. V1 and V2 both entered the intersection and the front of V1 impacted the front of V2.
V1 was traveling eastbound when the front struck the back of V2.
V1 crossed over the center lane. The front of V1 was struck/run-over by the left rear wheels of V2.
V2 was stopped facing northbound in the right turn lane waiting to turn right when the back was struck by the front of V1.
V1's left rear tire had a blow out. V1 went right across the centerline and the right front struck the left front of V2.
V1 was traveling in the number one lane of a divided highway behind V2, a NON-CDS vehicle also in the number one lane when the front of V1 and the back of V2's trailer collided.
V1, turning left to go east was struck on the left side by the front of V2 going west.
V1 entered a 4-way intersection and the left front was struck by the front of V2.
V1 turned left when the right side was struck by the front of V2 traveling eastbound.

V1 was traveling northbound when the driver lost control. The vehicle departed the left side of the roadway and began to rotate counter clockwise. As the vehicle was rotating the front of the vehicle struck a dirt canal bank and the vehicle traveled up the embankment and vaulted across the canal where the right side struck the far canal wall.
Vehicle one (V1) was turning left at an intersection. V2 was crossing the same intersection. The front of V1 struck the front of V2.

V1 was traveling eastbound in the number three lane of a five lane urban roadway approaching an intersection intending to turn left. V2 was westbound in the number three lane approaching the same intersection intending to go straight. V1 and V2 collided front to front in the intersection.
V1 entered the intersection and the front struck the left side of V2.
V1 attemped to turn left into a private drive when the right side was struck by the front of V2.

V1 was traveling eastbound in the left turn lane approaching a traffic-controlled intersection intending to turn left. V2 was westbound in the number 2 lane on the same roadway approaching the same intersection and intending to go straight. V1 entered the intersection and the right side was struck by the front of V2.
V1 was traveling eastbound on a bituminous urban roadway. V2 was stopped for traffic ahead of V1. The front of V1 struck the back of V2.

V1 was traveling eastbound approaching an intersection intending to go straight. V2 was approaching the same intersection going south intending to go straight. As V1 entered the intersection the left side was struck by the front of V2
V1 entered the intersection to turn left; the left front was struck by the front of V2.
V1 entered the intersection and was struck on the right side by the front of V2. After impact, V2 rotated and V1 rotated, causing the right side of V1 to side slap the left side of V2.

V1 was traveling in the two way left turn lane approaching a private drive intending to turn left. V2 was traveling in the number two lane when V1 turned left and the front of V2 struck the right side of V1.
V1 was traveling eastbound in the number two lane when the front struck the back of V2 which was stopped in the number two eastbound lane.
V1 entered the number 1 lane and the right side of V1 impacted V2 in the number 1 lane.

V1 was traveling northbound towing a bailer approaching a four-way intersection intending to turn left. As V1 turned left the right side of the bailer was struck by the front of V2 traveling southbound.

V1 was traveling westbound in the left turn lane approaching a intersection to turn left. V1 turned and the front struck the front of V2. V2 was traveling eastbound in the #1 lane of travel entered a intersection.

V1 was traveling eastbound in the left turn lane approaching a four-way intersection intending to turn left. V2 was traveling westbound in the number 3 lane approaching the same intersection intending to go straight. As V1 turned left the right front was struck by the front of V2. After impact V1 rotated counterclockwise and the right rear side slapped the left rear of V2.
V1 was approaching an intersection. V2 was approaching the same intersection. The front of V1 struck the left side of V2.

V1 was traveling eastbound approaching a four way intersection controlled by stop signs for east and westbound traffic. The brakes locked up and the vehicle slid into the intersection where the right side was struck by the front of V2, which was traveling northbound.

V1 was traveling north bound on a two lane rural roadway approaching an intersection to make a left hand turn. V2 was traveling south bound on a two lane rural roadway approaching the same intersection. V1 turned and the front was struck by the front of V2.

V1 was traveling in the left turn lane approaching an intersection to make a U-turn. V2 was traveling in the #1 lane approaching the same intersection. The front of V1 struck the left side of V2 in the #1 lane.
V1 was traveling eastbound in the number two lane and V2 was stopped facing east. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2.
V1 went off the right side of the roadway and the front struck the back of V2, a legally parked vehicle. V1 was facing southbound at final rest with the front still in contact with V2.

V1 entered the intersection and the left side was struck by the front of V2. After impact V1 rotated clockwise and V2 rotated counterclockwise and the left side of V1 side slapped the right side of V2.

V1 and V2 were traveling westbound in the #1 lane on a rural, two lane, interstate roadway when the back of V1 was struck by the front of V2. V1 was under the front of V2 at final rest facing westerly on the north side of the interstate roadway.
V1 passed through the intersection and the right side was struck by the front of V2.
V1 attempted to turn left into a private drive when the right side was struck by the front of V2 going westbound.

V1 turned left and the front of V2 and the right side of V1 collided in the number one eastbound lane. The impact rotated V1 counterclockwise and it had sustained contact with V2's left side as V2 was redirected on a trajectory somewhat clockwise of its precrash heading. V2 continued on that heading, departed the road to the right and had a front impact with a large wooden utility pole, then came to final rest against the pole.

V1 stopped and was going to turn left. V2 was traveling eastbound on a two lane rural roadway approaching a T-intersection. The front of V1 struck the front of V2. V1 at POI rotated in a clockwise direction and was on its wheels at final rest facing east. V2 was facing eastbound on the roadway at final rest.
V1 and V2 entered the intersection at the same time. V1's front struck the left side of V2. V2 rotated counterclockwise and its front impacted the left side of V1.
V1 made a U-turn and the left side was struck by the front of V2.
V1 was traveling northbound approaching a four way intersection. As it entered the intersection the left side was struck by the front of V2 which was traveling eastbound on the intersecting roadway.
V2 stopped for traffic and the back was struck by the front of V1.

V1 was exiting a private drive turning left onto a five-lane roadway. V2 was going east in the number 2 lane of the same roadway. The front of V1 and right side of V2 collided. V1 came to a stop in the #2 eastbound lane heading in an easterly direction. V2 came to rest in the center turn lane facing generally east.

Vehicle #1 was westbound when its front bumper plane contacted the rear bumper plane of Vehicle #2. Vehicle #1 came to rest at the impact location facing west. Vehicle #2 was properly parked to the right of westbound traffic and unoccupied when its rear bumper plane was contacted by the front bumper plane of Vehicle #1. Vehicle #2 then traveled forward over the curb to the right, rotated clockwise as it traveled over the front lawn of a private residence and contacted the brick wall of the residence with its front bumper plane and came to rest facing northwest.

V1 was stopped at the east entrance of the intersection waiting to turn left. V1 began to turn left and had a non-contact vehicle blocking the view of the #1 northbound lane. V1 impacted V2 with its front plane. V1 rotated slightly to the right and came to rest in the intersection. V2 was northbound in the #1 lane passing thru the intersection and was impacted on the right side by V1. V2 continued thru the intersection and came to rest off the right road edge.

Vehicle #1 was northbound in the #2 traffic lane, when its front bumper end plane contacted the rear bumper end plane of Vehicle #2. Vehicle #1 rotated counter-clockwise and came to rest in the #2 traffic lane facing north. Vehicle #2 was northbound in the #2 traffic lane when its rear bumper end plane was contacted by the front bumper end plane of Vehicle #1. Vehicle #2 came to a controlled stop in the #2 traffic lane facing north.

V1 entered the intersection from the south roadway and impacted V2 with its front plane. V1 continued across the intersection and came to rest on the north entrance of this intersection. V2 was eastbound crossing through this intersection and was impacted on the right side by V1. V2 came to rest on the edge of the #1 westbound travel lane pointing in an easterly direction. Both vehicles were towed for damages. Driver and occupant of vehicle #2 were treated and released at a local hospital.

two-vehicle crash occurred in a residential area on a two-lane straight and level roadway. Vehicle #1 was southbound when its front bumper plane contacted the rear bumper plane of Vehicle #2. Vehicle #1 came to rest at the point of impact in the southbound lane facing south. Vehicle #2 was stopped in the southbound lane when its rear bumper plane was contacted by the front bumper plane of Vehicle #1. Vehicle #2 came to rest at the point of impact in the southbound lane facing south.

V1 was northbound attempting to turn left at the intersection and impacted V2 with the front bumper. V1 rotated counterclockwise and came to a rest on the North side heading in a Southerly direction. V2 was westbound passing thru the intersection and was impacted on the left A pillar by V1. V2 rotated counterclockwise 180 degrees and the back impacted a fenced irrigation pump coming to rest on the North/West corner of this intersection heading in an easterly direction.

Vehicle #1 was eastbound in the #1 travel lane crossing through the intersection, when its front bumper plane contacted the front left side plane of Vehicle #2. Vehicle #2 was northbound, just entering the intersection, when its front left side plane was contacted by the front bumper plane of Vehicle #1.

Vehicle #1 was eastbound on the roadway when its front plane contacted the back plane of vehicle 2. After impact, vehicle #1 came to rest with its front end off the right road edge facing southeast. Vehicle #2 was stopped in the eastbound lane waiting for a vehicle to turn left when its back plane was contacted by the front of vehicle #1. After impact, vehicle #2 drove to the right side of the road east of the final rest of vehicle #1.
Vehicle #1 was eastbound and vehicle #2 was westbound in the #1 lane when V1 crossed the centerline and impacted the front side of V2 with its front plane.
V1 was southbound in the #1 travel lane and entered the intersection. V2 was eastbound crossing thru the intersection when it was impacted on the left plane by V1's front plane.

Vehicle 1 was southbound in the first lane of a three-lane, undivided, two-way, bituminous roadway on a rightward curve. V2 was northbound in the first lane of opposing traffic on the same roadway, curving left. V1 departed its lane to the left side, crossed the center lane, and entered the northbound lane. The front of V1 impacted the left side of V2 in a sideswipe pattern.

Vehicle #1 was eastbound and vehicle #2 was westbound when the front plane of V1 contacted the left front corner of V2. After impact, the two vehicles remained engaged and V2 came to rest with the RF wheel in the bar ditch and the front plane of V1 in contact with the LF wheel of V2. Both vehicles were towed due to damage.

This two vehicle crash occurred in a four legged intersection. Vehicle #1 was southbound in the #2 travel lane. Vehicle #2 was westbound in the #1 travel lane. Both vehicles entered the intersection. V1 was impacted on the left side by the front of V2. V1 rotated clockwise and side slapped V2 with the left rear fender. V1 deflected right and came to rest on the westbound shoulder some 60 meters from the area of impact. V2 rotated clockwise and slid into the median then tripped, rolled down into a gully coming to rest on its wheels in the median, heading in a westerly direction.

Vehicle one (V1) was traveling northbound in the number two lane of a straight, undivided asphalt roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was stopped in the same lane. The front of V1 struck the back of V2; both vehicles came to rest at the point of impact.

Vehicle #2 was westbound in the #1 lane and began to slow for blocking traffic. Vehicle #1 was westbound in the #2 lane and approached Vehicle #2 that was slowing for traffic in the outer lane. As V1 began to pass V2 a horse mounted person entered the #2 lane. The driver of V1 steered right in an avoidance maneuver and impacted the left rear bumper of V2.

Vehicle #1 was southbound and executed a left-hand turn within the intersection. Vehicle #2 was northbound and impacted V1 with the front left bumper. V1 was impacted on the right front fender by V2. Vehicle #1 rotated 180 degrees coming to rest in the intersection heading in a westerly direction. Vehicle #2 came to rest within the intersection heading in a northeasterly direction.

Vehicle #1 was eastbound in the right turn lane and turned right, at the intersection, onto the southbound #1 lane of the highway. Vehicle #2 was southbound in the #1 lane when its front plane contacted the back plane of V1.

Vehicle #1 was behind Vehicle #2, and Vehicle #2 was turning left at the intersection when Vehicle #1 attempted to pass Vehicle #2 on the left. The front plane of Vehicle #1 contacted the left side of Vehicle #2. Vehicle #1 and Vehicle #2 came to rest at the point of impact.

V1 was traveling eastbound in the first lane of a two-lane, two-way, undivided, bituminous roadway, curving right. V2 was traveling westbound in the first lane of opposing traffic. V1 departed the right road edge, corrected left, and crossed into the westbound traffic lane, the front of V1 impacted the front of V2.
Vehicle #1 was westbound and proceeded through the intersection, contacted on its right side by the front plane of Vehicle #2.
Vehicle #1 was southbound in the #1 lane and vehicle #2 was northbound, turning left from the center left turn lane, when the front plane of V1 contacted the front-right corner of V2.
Vehicle #1 was northbound, stopped at the stop sign. Vehicle #2 was westbound in the #1 lane. V1 continued north across the intersection when its right side was contacted by the front plane of V2.

Vehicle #1 was northbound and vehicle #2 was southbound when V1 departed the road edge, steered left to re-enter the roadway and crossed the centerline, where it contacted the left side of V2 with its front plane. After impact, V1 continued across the southbound lane, departed the road edge, climbed a cutback embankment, struck two rocks with the undercarriage, and came to rest facing northeast. After impact, V2 continued southbound until it was safe to pull off the road and parked.

Vehicle #1, a cargo van, was backing out of a parking place on the west side of the roadway and Vehicle #2, a van, was driving southbound, when the left-rear corner of V1 contacted the right-front fender of V2.

Vehicle #1 was westbound, turning left at the intersection, when its front-right corner was contacted by the front plane of Vehicle #2. After initial contact, Vehicle #1 was pushed backward, rotating counter-clockwise, and came to rest facing northeast. Vehicle #2 was eastbound when its front plane contacted the front-right corner of Vehicle #1. After initial contact, Vehicle #2 steered off the right road edge and came to rest with the front wheels straddling the westbound fog line, facing approximately northeast.

This two vehicle crash occurred on a four lane divided highway. Both vehicles were driving north in the #1 lane going uphill with the roadway curving to the left. V1 was northbound in the #1 lane going uphill. V2 was northbound in the #1 lane going uphill also. V1 was approaching V2 at a greater speed and the front plane of V1 struck the rear plane of V2. V2 went straight and to the right side of lane #1 and struck the right side guardrail with the right plane of V2. V2 then went into a counterclockwise yawing rotation crossing the #2 lane and struck the left side guardrail with the left front plane of V2. V2 continued straight in the #2 lane coming to rest off the left side of the roadway at the end of the guardrail. V1, after striking V2 continued straight, under full control of steering, and pulled off the road to the left of lane #2 and parked.

Vehicle #1 was traveling eastbound and Vehicle #2 was traveling southbound when the front plane of V1 contacted the right trailer wheels of V2. After initial impact, V1 rotated clockwise and its back plane contacted the right side of V2.

V1 was northbound when it crossed the southbound lane to avoid hitting an animal in the roadway. As V1 was in the southbound lane, V2 was southbound and the right front plane of V1 struck the right front plane of V2.
Vehicle #1 was northbound and vehicle #2 was southbound when the front plane of V1 contacted the front plane of V2. Prior to the crash, V2 had come to a stop in the southbound lane.
Vehicle #1 was northbound and Vehicle #2 was southbound, when the front plane of V1 contacted the left side of V2's trailer.

V1 was traveling eastbound in the first lane of a two-lane, two-way, undivided, bituminous roadway, about to cross an intersection. V2 was traveling northbound in the third lane of a three-lane, divided bituminous roadway, passing through the same intersection. As both vehicles entered the intersection, the front of V2 impacted the right side of V1.
V1 was westbound when it crossed over into the eastbound lane. The right front plane of V1 struck the right front plane of V2.
Vehicle #1 was eastbound in the #2 lane and Vehicle #2 was northbound, exiting the driveway and turning left, when the front plane of V1 contacted the left-front corner of V2.

V1 proceeded to make a left turn. V1 front plane impacted the front plane of V2. V1 rotated counterclockwise and came to final rest approximately 50m west of the intersection. V2 rotated counterclockwise slightly, continued thru the intersection coming to final rest just west of the intersection.
Vehicle #1 was eastbound in the #2 lane and Vehicle #2 was also eastbound in the #2 lane, stopped at the intersection. The front plane of V1 contacted the back plane of V2.

Vehicle #1 was southbound, stopped at the stop sign and Vehicle #2 was westbound in the #1 lane of the highway. V1 proceeded to turn left on the highway when its front place contacted the right side of V2.

This two vehicle crash occurred at an intersection of two, two lane roadways. The intersection is controlled with traffic lights. A painted solid yellow line divides the north-southbound roadway. V1 was southbound and V2 was stopped at a traffic light. The front plane of V1 contacted the rear plane of V2.

V1 drifted into the northbound lane. V2 was northbound and braked, steered right, departed the roadway, steered left, re-entered the roadway, braked with lockup, and collided front to front offset with V1. The left front suspensions of the 2 vehicles engaged briefly, then V2 overrode the suspension, continued down the driver side of V1, snagged in the LR suspension area of V1, rotated counterclockwise, and came to rest off the east edge of the roadway facing south. V1 departed the impact with V2 on a trajectory, resulting in V2 departing the west edge of the road and coming to rest on the southbound roadway edge facing southwest.

Vehicle one (V1) was turning left at the intersection, crossing southbound traffic lanes, and vehicle 2 (V2) was southbound in the #2 lane. The front of V2 struck the right rear quarter panel of V1, causing V1 to rotate CW and the right side struck the right side of V2.

V1 was westbound in the number one lane and V2 was stopped at the intersection ahead of V1. V1's front plane and the rear plane of V2 collided. The 2 vehicles came to final rest near the point of impact in the original lane of travel on their approximate original headings.
Vehicle #1 was turning left intending to go north on the highway and Vehicle #2 was southbound in the #1 lane when the front plane of V2 contacted the left side of V1.
Vehicle #1 was northbound, turning left at the intersection and Vehicle #2 was eastbound in the #2 lane, when the front of V2 contacted the left side of V1.
V1 was northbound and crossed into the southbound lane as it entered the left hand curve. V2 entered the curve southbound and the V2 front plane and V1 left plane collided.
Vehicle one (V1) was eastbound in the right lane. V2 was in lane two. As V2 passed V1, the right lane was ending and V1 merged to the left. The front of V2 struck the left side of V1.

V1 was eastbound when a u-turn was attempted at the top of hillcrest, V1 stalled out facing a northerly direction. V2 was eastbound when cresting the hill swerved into the westbound lane in an avoidance maneuver, when the tanker trailer landing gear struck the left plane of V1. V1 slid laterally, and the left side of V1 impacted the right side of V2.
Vehicle #1 was southbound and vehicle #2 was westbound when the front plane of V1 contacted the right side of V2.

Vehicle #1 was eastbound intending to go straight and vehicle #2 was northbound intending to turn left. The front plane of V1 contacted the left side of V2 in the intersection. After impact, V1 moved left and north and came to rest in the intersection. V2 was pushed east and north.

Vehicle #1 was northbound on the secondary street, turning left onto the highway and vehicle #2 was eastbound in the #2 lane, when V2 contacted V1. After impact, V1 rotated clockwise and came to rest east of the intersection across both westbound lanes facing southeast and V2 rotated counter-clockwise and came to rest west of the intersection across the westbound lanes facing northwest.

Vehicle #1 was turning left onto the through highway and Vehicle #2 was eastbound on the through highway. The front plane of V2 contacted the left side of V1 and came to rest at the point of impact facing east in the intersection.
Vehicle #1 was traveling northbound and vehicle #2 was traveling southbound, when the front plane of V1 contacted the front plane of V2.

Vehicle #1 was northbound in the left turn lane, and V2 was southbound in the #1 travel lane, when V1 turned left and the front plane of V2 contacted the front plane of V1. V1 was southbound in lane 2. V1 was southbound on the same roadway in front of V1. V2 was stopped due to traffic. The front of V1 contacted the rear of V2. Both vehicles came to rest in the vicinity of the point of impact on their wheels.

V1 was eastbound on a straight, six-lane, divided, urban road. V1 was in the left turn lane. V2 was westbound on the same urban road. V2 was in the lane 3. V1 turned left as V2 entered the intersection. Both vehicles impacted head-on.

V1 rotated counterclockwise and came to rest in lane 1 of northbound traffic. V2 rotated counterclockwise and came to rest in lane 1 of the northbound traffic.
V1 was traveling northbound intending to go straight. V2 was traveling northbound ahead of V1 intending to go straight. V1's front contacted the back of V2.

V1 was eastbound approaching an intersection. V1 was in lane 3, the center through lane. V2 was northbound preparing to make a left turn. V2 was in lane two, the center left turn lane. V1 was traveling on a four-lane highway frontage road in lane 2. V2 was traveling on a four-lane, physically divided roadway in lane 2. V1 rotated counterclockwise and V2 rotated clockwise.

V1 was southbound on a divided highway approaching an intersection. V2 was eastbound on a divided local street. Both vehicles entered the intersection at the same time. V1 impacted with its front to V2's left side. V1 rotated slightly counterclockwise and came to rest facing southeast in the middle of the intersection. V2 rotated slightly clockwise and came to rest facing southeast in the middle of the intersection.

V1 was exiting the gas station through a gap to turn westbound onto the roadway. V2 was heading eastbound in lane 1 and changing lanes into lane 2, the left turn lane. V1 was eastbound on an undivided, straight, two-lane urban road. V1 traveled to a four-leg intersection with stop signs. V2 was northbound on an undivided, straight, two-lane urban road. V1 was traveling north in lane 3 intending to turn left. V2 was traveling south in lane 3 intending to go straight. The front of V1 contacted the front of V2.

V1 was southbound on a divided, six-lane, straight highway. V1 was in lane 1 traveling toward an intersection. V2 was northbound on the same highway. V2 was in lane 4, the inside left turn lane. V1 lost control and traveled into lane 2. The driver side mirror of V1 contacted the passenger side mirror of V2. The front left corner of V1 then contacted the back right corner of V3.

V1 was westbound on a straight, level, physically divided, eight-lane, state highway approaching an intersection. The westbound lanes consist of four through lanes and a left turn only lane. V1 was traveling westbound in lane 1. V2 was traveling westbound in the same lane in front of V1. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2. The impact pushed V2 into the concrete sound wall on the edge of the shoulder.

V1 was northbound in the through lane on a four-lane, uphill, left curve, urban road. V2 was eastbound in the through lane on a five-lane, level, straight, urban road. V1 rotated slightly clockwise and came to rest facing northeast in the middle of the intersection. V2 rotated slightly clockwise and came to rest facing southeast in the middle of the intersection.

V1 was traveling south on a divided state highway. V1 was in lane 4, the outside through lane. V2 was also traveling south in lane 4 of the same highway. V1 traveled forward and came to rest in lane 4 facing south. V2 was pushed forward and also came to rest in lane 4 facing south.

V1 was eastbound on a divided, six-lane, straight, urban road. V1 was in lane 4, the left turn lane. V2 was westbound on a divided, six-lane, straight, urban road. V1 was traveling northbound in lane two of the highway negotiating a left curve. V2 pulled into the highway from a private drive to use the crossover to head southbound. The front of V1 contacted the left rear wheels and frame of the V2.

V1 was westbound in lane 2 on a five-lane undivided urban street approaching an intersection. V2 was southbound on a five-lane undivided state highway approaching the same intersection. V1 was traveling westbound in lane 2. V2 was also traveling westbound in front of V1. V2 was slowing for traffic. V1's front end contacted the back of V2. V1 was traveling east in lane 1. V2 was traveling west in lane 4, the furthest left turn lane. V1 was northbound on a divided, six-lane, straight, state highway. V1 was in lane 2, the outside through lane. V2 was southbound on a divided, seven-lane, straight, state highway. V1 was westbound on a three-lane, undivided, suburban road in lane 1. The westbound side of the road consists of a through lane and a left turn lane. V1 was southbound in lane 6 on a physically divided, nine-lane, state highway approaching an intersection. V2 was northbound on the same state highway approaching the same intersection in lane 4. V1 was southbound in lane 2 on a three-lane, undivided state highway. V2 was northbound on the right shoulder of the same state highway pulling a trailer. V2 yawed counterclockwise onto the depressed grass shoulder. Its trailer jackknifed and contacted V2's left side. V2 came to rest on the grass shoulder facing northwest.

V1 was eastbound in lane 2, intending to go straight. V2 was northbound intending to go straight. The vehicles entered the intersection at the same time, and V1's front impacted V2's left side. V1 then rotated counterclockwise and V2 rotated clockwise and V1's right side and V2's left side side-slapped.

V1 entered the intersection to turn right. V2 proceeded across the intersection and impacted V1 with its front to left side. V1 was northbound in a five-lane, undivided, two-way, bituminous roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was westbound in a two-lane, divided roadway, about to turn left at the same intersection. As both vehicles entered the intersection, the front of V1 impacted the left side of V2.

V1 was southbound in lane 1 on a straight, physically divided state highway approaching an intersection. V2 was also southbound in lane 1 in front of V1. V2 crossed the intersection and stopped at the bus stop to load passengers. V1 crossed the intersection behind V2. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2. Both vehicles came to rest in lane 1 near the point of impact.

V1 was southbound intending to go straight. V2 was stopped ahead in the same lane, waiting to make a left turn. The front of V1 impacted the rear of V2. V2 was pushed forward, coasted south using the momentum of the collision and its own power, then turned right onto another roadway. V2 came to rest facing southwest on the north side of the road.

V1 was westbound in the first lane of a two-lane, divided highway. V2 was westbound in lane one of the same roadway, ahead of V1. V1 was southbound in lane 4 of a straight state highway approaching an intersection. V2 was northbound in lane 3 on the same state highway approaching the same intersection. V2 continued down the road and came to a controlled final rest in lane 1.

V1 was westbound intending to go straight through the intersection. V2 was southbound intending to go straight through the intersection. The front of V1 contacted the left side of V2 in the middle of the intersection.

V1 was traveling in the fourth lane of a divided bituminous roadway, about to turn left at an intersection. V2 was traveling in the fourth lane of a divided bituminous roadway, approaching the same intersection. As both vehicles entered the intersection, the front of V2 impacted the left side of V1. Both vehicles rotated counter-clockwise from impact.

V1 was traveling northbound in lane 4 intending to turn left at the intersection. V2 was traveling south in lane 2 intending to go straight through the intersection. The front of V2 contacted the right side of V1 in the intersection.
V1 was traveling westbound in lane 1. V2 was traveling southbound in lane 3. Both vehicles entered the intersection intending to go straight. The front of V1 contacted the left side of V2.

V1 was westbound in lane 4 on a state highway approaching an intersection. V2 was eastbound in lane 2 on the same highway approaching the same intersection. V1 entered the intersection intending to turn left. V2 entered the intersection intending to go straight. The front of V1 contacted the front of V2.

V1 was eastbound on a two-lane, undivided, mountain road negotiating a left curve. V2 was westbound on the same mountain road also negotiating a left curve. V1 entered the westbound lanes as it attempted to pass a dump truck. The front of V1 contacted the front of V2.

V1 was traveling northbound in the second lane of a six-lane, divided bituminous roadway, approaching an intersection. As both vehicles entered the intersection, the front of V1 impacted the left side of V2.

V1 was southbound in the left turn lane on a divided five-lane highway. V2 was northbound in the inside through lane of the same highway. V1 proceeded with a left turn as V2 entered the intersection to continue straight. V2's front impacted the right side of V1. V1 rotated clockwise and came to rest facing west. V2 rotated slightly clockwise and came to rest facing northeast.
V1 was traveling north intending to turn left at the intersection. V2 was traveling south intending to go straight. The front of V2 contacted the right side of V1.

V1 was westbound in a parking lot approaching an urban street. V1 stopped at the street and waited for traffic to clear. V2 was northbound on the urban street. V1 pulled out onto the road intending to turn right. The left side of V1 contacted the front of V2. V1 and V2 came to rest against each other at poi.

V1 was westbound in lane 3 on an urban street approaching an intersection. V2 was northbound in lane 1 approaching the same intersection. V1 entered the intersection intending to go straight. V2 entered the intersection intending to go straight. The left side of V1 contacted the front of V2. Both vehicles yawed counterclockwise across the intersection.
V1 slid on the snowpacked roadway and contacted its front with the back of V2.

V1, a vehicle, was westbound on a road approaching a T-intersection. V2, another vehicle, was northbound on a road approaching the same intersection. V2 moved forward and to the left, pushing V1 ahead of it. Both vehicles came to rest in the lane north of the intersection. The front of V2 was against the left side of V1.
V1 was traveling northbound intending to turn left at the intersection. V2 was traveling intending to go straight. The front of V1 contacted the left side of V2.

V1 was traveling westbound in lane three intending to go straight. V2 was stopped on the left shoulder of the highway with its overhead lights activated. V1 was negotiating a left hand curve when the driver lost control of the vehicle and rotated counterclockwise and exited the left side of the highway. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2. V1 was northbound in lane 1 of an eight-lane, straight, level, physically divided highway approaching an intersection. V2 was pushed to the left into lane 3.

V1 was eastbound in lane 3 on a straight, six-lane roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was westbound in lane 3 on the same roadway. As V1 turned left at the intersection, the right side was struck by the front of V2.

Vehicle one (V1), a pickup, was eastbound in lane two on an undivided, three-lane roadway, approaching an intersection. V2, a car, was southbound in lane two on a seven-lane, undivided intersecting roadway. As V1 turned left at the intersection, the left side was struck by the front of V2.
V1 was traveling southbound in lane three intending to go straight. V2 was traveling eastbound in lane three intending to turn left at the intersection. The front of V1 contacted the left side of V2.

Vehicle one (V1) was in lane three, intending to turn left at an intersection. V2 was traveling southbound in lane two of the same roadway. In the intersection, the front of V1 struck the front of V2.

V1 was westbound on a dry, two-lane, undivided, sharply curved, rural road. V2 was eastbound on the same rural road. V1 slid down the left side of V2 and pushed V2 to the left. V1 then rotated counterclockwise off the right side of the road. V2 went off the right side of the road and contacted a barbwire fence with its front. The front of V2 contacted some willow bushes.

V1 was traveling eastbound in lane two intending to go straight. V2 was traveling eastbound in lane one, slightly ahead of V1, intending to change lanes to exit onto the other interstate. V2 crossed into lane two directly in front of V1. V1 lost control on the icy road and contacted the front left corner to the right side of V2. The impact caused V1 and V2 to rotate clockwise. V1 and V2 exited the right side of the highway.

V1 was traveling northbound intending to go straight. V2 was stopped for a red light in lane two of northbound traffic ahead of V1. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2. V1 and V2 came to final rest in the vicinity of the point of impact on their wheels facing north.

V1 was traveling westbound intending to go straight through the intersection. V2 was traveling northbound intending to go straight through the intersection. V1 was northbound in lane three on a physically divided, five-lane urban street approaching an intersection. V2 was southbound on the same urban street in lane two approaching the same intersection.
