The right side of V1 contacted the front of V2. V2 pushed V1 forward and to the right. Both vehicles came to rest near the southwest corner of the intersection.

V1 was westbound in lane 2 on a six-lane, straight, level, physically divided US highway. V2 was westbound on the same highway in lane 1. V1 changed lanes into lane 1. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2, pushing it forward. All four vehicles came to rest in lane 1 facing west.

V1 was westbound in lane 2 on an urban street approaching an intersection. V2 was southbound on a private driveway preparing to enter the westbound lanes of the urban street. V1 entered lane 3 to pass the two non-contact vehicles. After it passed the vehicles, V1 re-entered lane 2. V2 turned right onto the roadway, crossing lane 1 and entering lane 2. The front of V1 then contacted the back of V3. V1 came to rest in lane 2 against the back of V3 facing west. V3 moved forward slightly and came to rest in lane 2 facing west.

The crash occurred on a straight, divided, two-lane, uphill, bituminous, state highway. V1 was traveling westbound in lane two intending to go straight. V2 was traveling westbound in lane two, directly in front of V1, intending to go straight. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2. V1 came to final rest near the point of impact with V2 on its wheels facing west. V2 came to final rest near the point of impact with V1 on its wheels facing west.
The front of V1 contacted the rear of V2. V1 pushed V2 forward.
V1 exited the driveway intending to turn left. V2 was traveling in lane two intending to go straight. V1 entered the roadway and the front of V2 contacted the left side of V1.

V1 was northbound in lane 2 on a straight, five-lane, undivided, state highway. V2 was southbound on the same state highway in lane 2. V1 lost control and crossed into the southbound lanes. The front of V1 contacted the left side of V2. Both vehicles spun counterclockwise after the collision. V1 came to rest in the center turn lane. V2 spun off the right side of the road and came to rest on a curbed island.

V1 was traveling westbound intending to go straight and began to rotate counterclockwise, crossing the center turn lane into eastbound traffic lanes. The front of V2 contacted the right side of V1. V1 crossed through the intersection and entered the southbound lanes. The front of V1 contacted the front of V2. Both vehicles rotated clockwise.

V1 was southbound in lane 2 on an undivided suburban street approaching an intersection. V2 was northbound in lane 2 on the same suburban street approaching the same intersection. V1 entered the intersection intending to turn left. V2 entered the intersection intending to go straight. The front of V1 contacted the front of V2.

V1 was traveling westbound in lane three intending to go straight. V2 was traveling in lane three, in front of V1, intending to go straight. V2 was stopped behind the non-contact vehicle when the front of V1 contacted the back of V2.

V1 was westbound in lane 4 approaching an intersection. V2 was eastbound in lane 2 approaching the same intersection. V1 entered the intersection intending to turn left. V1 came to rest in a parking lot facing southwest. V2 came to rest in the eastbound lane facing southwest.

V1 was eastbound in lane 4 on a physically divided suburban street approaching an intersection. V2 was westbound on the same suburban street approaching the same intersection. V1 entered the intersection intending to turn left. V2 entered the intersection intending to go straight. The right side of V1 contacted the front of V2.

V1 was traveling westbound intending to go straight through the intersection. V2 was traveling southbound intending to turn left at the intersection. The front of V1 contacted the left side of V2. V1 and V2 rotated counterclockwise. The left side of V1 then contacted the left side of V2.

V1 was northbound in lane two on a physically divided state highway approaching an intersection. V2 was westbound in lane 3 on an undivided urban street approaching the same intersection. V1 entered the intersection intending to go straight. V2 entered the intersection intending to go straight. The front of V1 contacted the left side of V2. V1 was pushed to the left.

V1 was southbound in lane 2 on an undivided state highway. V2 was northbound in lane 2 on the same state highway. V1 drove across the double yellow line into the northbound lanes. The front of V1 contacted the front of V2. Both vehicles bounced slightly back from the point of impact. V1 came to rest facing south in northbound lane 1. V2 came to rest facing northeast in northbound lane 1.

V1 was traveling eastbound in lane three intending to go straight. V2 was traveling eastbound in lane three, ahead of V1, intending to go straight. V2 stopped suddenly for traffic. V1 was traveling eastbound intending to turn left. V2 was traveling southbound intending to go straight through the intersection. Both vehicles entered the intersection, the left side of V1 was struck by the front of V2 in the middle of the intersection.

V1 was northbound approaching a stop sign in a parking lot. V2 was driving westbound through the parking lot. V1 stopped and then proceeded into the parking lot. The front of V1 contacted the left side of V2.

V1 was stopped southbound in lane one intending to turn left at the intersection. V2 was traveling westbound in lane one intending to go straight through the intersection. V1 entered the intersection and its left side contacted the front of V2. V1 rotated clockwise as V2 rotated counterclockwise. The left side of V1 contacted the right side of V2.

V1 was turning left from a parking lot to cross northbound traffic to go southbound. V2 was traveling northbound in lane one intending to go straight. As V1 pulled into the northbound lanes, V2 steered to the left. The front of V1 contacted the front of V2 in lane three of northbound traffic lanes. V1 continued to rotate clockwise and came to final rest on its wheels facing northeast in lane two of northbound traffic lanes. After impact with V1, V2 continued to the northwest and came to final rest on its wheels facing north in lane two of southbound traffic.

This two-vehicle crash occurred at a three-way traffic controlled intersection. V1 was traveling northbound intending to turn left at the intersection. V2 was traveling eastbound intending to go straight through the intersection. As the vehicles entered the intersection, the front of V1 contacted the right side of V2.

V1, a sedan, was southbound in lane 2 negotiating a right curve on a physically divided state highway approaching an interchange. V2, a sedan, was southbound in lane 3 on the same state highway. V1 changed lanes to the left into lane 3. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2.

V1 was southbound on a state highway approaching an intersection. V2 was northbound on the same state highway approaching the same intersection. V1 entered the intersection intending to turn left. V2 entered the intersection intending to go straight. The right side of V1 contacted the front of V2. Both vehicles rotated clockwise. V1 came to rest in the middle of the intersection facing northwest. V2 came to rest in the middle of the intersection facing southwest.

V1 was traveling eastbound in lane two negotiating a right curve. V2 was traveling eastbound in lane three negotiating a right curve. As V1 was negotiating the right curve, it hydroplaned on the wet roadway and crossed to the left into lane three. The front of V1 contacted the right side of V2.

V1 was northbound in lane 5 on a state highway approaching an intersection. V2 was southbound in lane 3 on the same highway approaching the same intersection. V1 entered the intersection intending to turn left. V2 entered the intersection intending to go straight. The right side of V1 contacted the front of V2. V2 pushed V1 south. Both vehicles came to rest on the south side of the intersection near the northbound lanes facing southwest.

V1 was traveling northbound intending to go straight. V2 was traveling south in lane one intending to go straight. V1 crossed into the southbound travel lanes. V1 was exiting a parking lot on the north side of the roadway, intending to turn left. V2 was traveling westbound in lane one intending to go straight. V2 changed lanes to the left to allow V1 to exit the parking lot. V1 pulled into the westbound lanes. V2 swerved into the eastbound traffic lanes to avoid V1. The front of V1 contacted the right side of V2 in lane two of eastbound traffic lanes. After the impact, V1 continued traveling to the southwest and exited the roadway.

V1 and V2 were westbound in lane 4 on an interstate highway. V2 was in front of V1. V2 stopped for the traffic. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2 pushing it forward. Both vehicles came to rest west of the POI in lane 4 facing west.

Vehicle one (V1) was traveling eastbound in lane three of a divided roadway. V2 was traveling in the same lane in front of V1. The front of V1 struck the back of V2. V1 and V2 came to final rest on their wheels facing east near the point of impact.

Vehicle one (V1) and V2 were northbound in lane three of a divided, seven-lane roadway. The front of V1 struck the back of V2. Both vehicles came to rest in lane three near the area of impact, facing north.

V1 was northbound in lane 3 on a 5-lane, undivided roadway approaching an intersection. V2 was southbound in lane 2 on the same roadway. V1 entered the intersection intending to turn left. The right side of V1 was struck by the front of V2. V1 yawed across the intersection and came to rest in the right turn lane on the southwest corner. V2 continued south across the intersection and came to rest near the traffic island.

Vehicle one (V1) and V2 were stopped southbound in lane four on a roadway at an intersection. V1 was behind V2. V1 started to move forward and the front struck the back of V2. Both vehicles came to rest in lane four facing south a few feet south of the impact.

V1 was traveling southeast on the off-ramp, negotiating the curve, intending to merge onto the southbound traffic lanes. V2 was traveling southeast on the off-ramp, negotiating the curve, directly in front of V1. As the vehicles approached the southbound lanes, V2 stopped. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2.

V1 was eastbound on a two-lane state highway negotiating a left curve at a high rate of speed. As V1 rounded the curve, it ran off the right side of the road and entered a shallow drainage ditch. V1 continued east in the drainage ditch for about 180 m. As it drove in the drainage ditch, it contacted its front left and front right corners and left and right sides several times with the sides of the ditch. V1 came to rest in the ditch facing east.

Vehicle one (V1) was traveling eastbound in the third lane of a three-lane, divided concrete roadway, about to turn left into a private drive. Vehicle two (V2) was traveling westbound in the second lane of a two-lane, divided, concrete roadway, approaching the private drive on its right. As V1 made its turn, the front of V2 impacted the right side of V1.

V1 was westbound attempting to turn left into a private drive. V2 was eastbound intending to turn right at the intersection. V1 turned left and entered the eastbound traffic lanes through a break in traffic. The front of V2 contacted the right side of V1. V1 came to final rest near the point of impact with V2 facing south. V2 came to final rest near the point of impact with V1 facing east.

Vehicle one (V1) was eastbound in lane one of a roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was stopped directly in front of V1. The front of V1 struck the back of V2. Both vehicles came to final rest near the point of impact facing east.

V1 was eastbound in lane one of a two-lane, undivided, level, right-curve roadway. V2 was westbound on the same roadway. As V1 turned left into a parking lot, the right side was struck by the front of V2.

V1 was southbound intending to go straight and swerved to the right to avoid a non-contact vehicle. V1 overcorrected to the left and began to yaw counterclockwise into the northbound lane. V2 was northbound and swerved to avoid V1. The front of V2 contacted the right rear side of V1. V1 came to final rest facing south. V2 came to final rest facing east.

V1 was eastbound in lane 2 on a physically divided, urban street approaching an intersection. V2 was southbound in lane 1 on an undivided, urban street approaching the same intersection. V1 entered the intersection intending to go straight. V2 entered the intersection intending to go straight. The front of V1 contacted the right side of V2.

Vehicle one (V1) was westbound in lane four of a divided, level, straight roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was eastbound in lane two on the same roadway. V1 turned left in the intersection and struck V2. After the impact, V1 traveled to the southeast and came to final rest in the SE corner of the intersection facing SE. V2 rotated and traveled to the southeast and came to final rest in the SE corner of the intersection, facing north.

Vehicle one (V1) was westbound in lane three of a six-lane, divided, level, straight roadway, intending to turn left into a driveway. V2, a Ford Ranger, was eastbound in lane three of the same roadway. As V1 turned, the right side was struck by the front of V2.

Vehicle one (V1) was westbound in lane two on a four-lane, undivided roadway. V2 was stopped in the westbound lane 2 on the same roadway in front of V1. The front of V1 struck the back of V2. Both vehicles came to rest a few feet west of the point of impact facing west.

Vehicle one (V1) was westbound on an undivided, three-lane roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was southbound on an intersecting undivided, three-lane roadway. In the intersection, the front of V1 struck the left side of V2.

Vehicle one (V1) was southbound in lane four of a divided, seven-lane roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was northbound in lane two on the same roadway. V1 turned left at the intersection and the front of V1 struck the front of V2. V1 rotated CCW after the impact and V2 was pushed to the right. Both vehicles came to rest in the middle of the intersection facing northeast and were towed due to damage.
Vehicle one was westbound on an undivided two-lane roadway. Vehicle two was eastbound on the same roadway. Vehicle one traveled over the left lane line and the front struck the front of vehicle two.

Vehicle one (V1) was southbound in lane two of an undivided six-lane, bituminous, curved and level roadway. V2 was northbound in lane two of the same roadway. V1 crossed over both turn lanes and the front struck the left side of V2.

Vehicle one (V1) was northbound in the number three lane of a five-lane, divided, straight, downhill roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was stopped northbound in the number two lane at the intersection. As V1 changed lanes to the right, the front struck the back of V2.

Vehicle one (V1) was westbound in lane one of a three-lane undivided roadway. V2 was eastbound on the same roadway. V1 crossed over the left turn lane into lane one of eastbound traffic and struck the left side of V2.

Vehicle one (V1) was traveling eastbound in the left-turn lane of a divided, straight, level roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was traveling westbound in lane two of the same roadway. As V1 turned left, the front of V2 struck the right side of V1.

Vehicle one (V1) was northbound in lane three of a seven-lane, divided, straight, roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was stopped northbound in the same lane. The front of V1 struck the back of V2. Both vehicles came to rest in the original travel lane and were towed due to damage.

Vehicle one (V1) was northbound in lane two of a four-lane, straight, undivided roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was eastbound in lane three of a seven-lane, undivided, straight, intersecting roadway. In the intersection, the front of V1 struck the right side of V2. V1 continued traveling north and came to final rest north of the intersection. V2 rotated CW and came to rest east of the intersection.

Vehicle one (V1) was westbound on an on-ramp, intending to merge onto a divided roadway. V2 was westbound in lane one of the roadway. V1 began to rotate CCW, crossed the gore and the front struck the right side of V2. V1 then yawed CW and came to rest on the right shoulder facing east. V2 came to rest on the roadway, facing west.

V1 was westbound in lane three of a divided roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was eastbound in lane one of the same roadway. As V1 turned left at the intersection, the right side was struck by the front of V2. The vehicles rotated and the right side of V1 struck the left side of V2.

Vehicle one (V1) was northbound on a two-lane, undivided, level, right-curve roadway. V2 was northbound in front of V1. The front of V1 struck the back of V2. V1 came to final rest facing north. V2 rotated CW and came to final rest facing south.

Vehicle one (V1) was southbound in lane four on a divided, straight, seven-lane roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was northbound in lane three on the same roadway. V1 turned left at the intersection and the right side was struck by the front of V2. V1 continued east across the intersection and came to rest on the raised median on the east side of the intersection, facing east. V2 rotated clockwise and came to rest in the middle of the intersection facing NE. Both vehicles were towed due to damage.

V1 was southbound in lane 1 on a divided state highway approaching an intersection. V2 was northbound in lane 4 on the same state highway approaching the same intersection. V1 entered the intersection intending to go straight. V2 entered the intersection intending to turn left. The front of V1 contacted the front of V2. Both vehicles came to rest near the point of impact after minor clockwise rotations.

Vehicle one (V1) was southbound in lane four of a seven-lane, downhill, right-curve, divided roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was stopped in front of V1. The front of V1 struck the back of V2. Both vehicles came to rest near the area of impact.

Vehicle one (V1) was southbound in lane three on a six-lane, straight, level roadway. V2 was northbound in lane one on the same roadway. V1 turned left in to a driveway and the right side was struck by the front of V2. The vehicles rotated and the right side of V1 struck the left side of V2. Both vehicles came to rest near the driveway and were towed due to damage.

Vehicle one (V1) was eastbound in lane one of a four-lane, straight, bituminous, straight, and level roadway. V2 was eastbound in lane one behind V1. V1 attempted to make a U-turn and the left side was struck by the front of V2. Both vehicles came to rest close to the point of impact.
Vehicle one (V1) was traveling southbound in lane three of a divided, straight, uphill roadway. V2 was in front of V1 and slowing for traffic. The front of V1 struck the back of V2.

Vehicle one (V1), was northbound in lane four on a divided roadway, approaching an intersection. V2, was southbound in lane two on the same roadway. V2 continued across the raised SW corner traffic island, across eastbound lane one and off the edge of the SW corner. The left side of V2 struck a signpost. V2 came to rest on the grass facing SW.

V1 was eastbound on a two-lane country road approaching an intersection. V2 was southbound in lane 2 on the interstate highway approaching the intersection. V1 entered the intersection intending to turn left. V2 entered the intersection intending to go straight. The front of V1 contacted the front of V2.

V1 was traveling northbound in lane four intending to turn left into the apartment complex. V2 was traveling southbound in lane three intending to go straight. The front of V1 contacted the front of V2.

V1 was westbound in lane 3 on a state highway approaching an interchange. V2 was eastbound in lane 2 on the same state highway approaching the same interchange. V1 entered the interchange intending to turn left. V2 entered the interchange intending to go straight. The front of V1 contacted the front of V2. V1 rotated counterclockwise and V2 rotated clockwise. The right side of V1 contacted the left side of V2. After this impact, both vehicles continued southeast across the intersection and exited the highway on the southeast corner. After V1 exited the highway, its front left tire contacted a cement block. V1 came to rest on an uphill grass embankment on the southeast corner facing southeast. V2 came to rest in a ditch on the southeast corner facing southeast.

Vehicle one (V1) was southbound in lane one approaching an intersection. V2 was stopped eastbound in lane two of the intersecting roadway. V1 turn right at the intersection and traveled over the left lane line. The front of V1 struck the front of V2.

Vehicle one (V1) was northbound in lane three of a divided, downhill, right-curved roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was westbound in lane two of the intersecting, three-lane, two-way, uphill, right-curved roadway. As V2 turned left at the intersection, the front of V1 struck the front of V2.

Vehicle one (V1) was northbound in a parking lot exit driveway, intending to turn left. V2 was eastbound in lane three of a divided, seven-lane roadway, approaching the driveway. As V1 turned left, the front struck the front of V2.

V1 was southbound in lane 3 on a 10-lane state highway approaching an intersection. V2 was eastbound in lane 3 on a 7-lane urban street approaching the same intersection. The front of V2 contacted the right side of V1.

V1 and V2 were southbound in lane 2 on a dry straight downhill state highway. V2 stopped because of a stalled car in front of it. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2 pushing it forward. V1 and V2 came to rest near the point of impact in lane 2 facing south.

Vehicle one (V1) was traveling westbound in lane one of a three-lane, straight, level, undivided roadway, approaching a T-intersection. V2, a bus, was traveling westbound in lane one directly in front of V1, intending to turn left at the intersection. V1 traveled into the eastbound lane to pass V2 as V2 was making the left turn. The front of V2 struck the right side of V1.

Vehicle one (V1), a pickup truck, was eastbound on a two-lane, straight, level roadway, approaching an intersection, intending to turn left. V2, a vehicle, was southbound in lane four of four on the intersecting roadway that was divided, straight and level. As V1 turned left, the front struck the front of V2.
Vehicle one (V1) was eastbound. V2 was westbound. V1 skidded into the westbound lane and the front struck the front of V2.

V1 was southbound approaching an intersection. V2 was westbound approaching the same intersection. The front of V2 contacted the left side of V1. V1 was pushed west, traveled south, and came to rest in southbound lane 2. V2 was dragged to the south and came to rest in the middle of the intersection.

V1 was northbound in lane 4 on a state highway approaching an intersection. V2 was southbound in lane 3 on the same state highway approaching the same intersection. V1 entered the intersection intending to turn left. V2 entered the intersection intending to go straight. The front of V2 contacted the right side of V1. The right side of V1 contacted the left side of V2. After this impact, V1 moved southwest across the intersection. V2 traveled west across the intersection.

V1 was southbound on a frontage road that intersects a state highway and is controlled by a stop sign. V2 was southbound in lane one of the state highway. While negotiating a right curve, V1 lost control and began rotating clockwise, and slid into the intersection. The right side of V1 was impacted by the front of V2.

V1 was southbound in lane 2 on a left curved, one way, downhill, undivided, 3-lane, exit ramp from an interstate highway. V2 was stopped facing south at the light in lane 3, at the end of the same ramp, waiting to turn left onto a state highway. V1 slid to the right and then to the left. As it slid to the left, V1 began to rotate counterclockwise. The right side of V1 contacted the back of V2. V1 then rotated counterclockwise around V2 and came to rest in lane 2 facing northeast. V2 was pushed slightly forward and came to rest near the point of impact still in lane 3 facing south.

This two-vehicle crash occurred on a two-lane, bituminous, curved, level, and icy state highway. V1 was eastbound in lane one negotiating a left hand curve. V2 was westbound in lane one negotiating a right hand curve. V1 began to slide and rotate counterclockwise. V1 then began to rotate clockwise and crossed over the left lane line. The front of V2 impacted the left side of V1. After the impact, V1 rotated counterclockwise and came to rest on the right hand side of the road facing west. V2 came to rest in westbound lane one facing northwest.

Vehicle one (V1) was stopped southbound in lane two of a five-lane, undivided, straight, uphill roadway intending to turn left at an intersection. V2 was southbound in lane two on the same roadway. The front of V2 struck the back of V1.

Vehicle one (V1) was northbound in lane four of a divided four-lane roadway, approaching an intersection intending to turn left. Vehicle two (V2) was southbound in lane three of the same roadway intending to cross the intersection. The front of V2 impacted the right side of V1 and came to rest on the eastbound roadway facing southwest. V1 came to rest on the eastbound roadway facing southwest.

V1 was southbound in lane 2 on a physically divided highway. V2 was northbound in lane 2 on the same highway. V1 began to yaw counterclockwise across the southbound lanes, traveled across the median into the northbound lanes. V2 moved into lane 3 to avoid a head-on collision. V1 turned to the right and collided head-on with V2 in northbound lane 3.

V1 was westbound in lane three on a divided roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was eastbound in lane two of the same roadway. As V1 turned left at the intersection, the front struck the front of V2.

Vehicle one (V1) was traveling northbound in lane one of three of a divided, level, straight roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was traveling southbound in lane two of the same roadway. V1 turned left at the intersection and the front struck the front of V2.

Vehicle one (V1) was northbound in lane four of a divided four-lane, bituminous, straight and level roadway, intending to turn left into a private drive. V2 was southbound in lane one of the same roadway. V1 turned left through traffic backed up from a traffic light to the south. The front of V2 impacted the right side of V1.

V1 was traveling westbound in a two-lane roadway. V2 was ahead of V1. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2 pushing it forward. All vehicles came to rest near the point of impact in the same lane still facing west.

Vehicle one (V1) was traveling on an eastbound frontage road and turned left (northbound) on a two-lane, level, straight roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was traveling eastbound on a divided, level, straight roadway, approaching the same intersection. V1 turned left in the intersection and the front struck the right side of V2.

V1 and V2 were westbound in lane 1 on a left-curved, physically divided, 3 lane, interstate highway approaching heavy traffic. V2 was in front of V1. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2 pushing it forward. Both vehicles came to rest in lane 1 facing west.

Vehicle one (V1) was eastbound in lane three of a divided, five-lane straight highway attempting to turn left at a traffic controlled interchange. V2 was westbound in lane two of the same highway attempting to go straight. The front of V2 struck the front of V1.

V1 was traveling southbound intending to go straight through the intersection. V2 was traveling eastbound intending to go straight through the intersection. The front of V1 contacted the left side of V2. V1 continued to travel to the south and came to final rest on the painted shoulder of southbound travel. After the impact with V1, V2 rotated counterclockwise and traveled to the southeast. V2 came to final rest facing northwest in lane one of northbound travel.

V1 was traveling southbound approaching the intersection intending to go straight. V2 was traveling eastbound intending to turn left at the intersection. The front of V1 contacted the front of V2 in the intersection. V1 rotated counterclockwise and came to final rest in the middle of the intersection on its wheels. After the impact with V1, V2 traveled to the southeast and contacted a plastic delineator post with its front.

V1 was traveling northbound in the third lane of a four-lane, divided roadway, about to turn left at an intersection. V2 was traveling southbound and crossing the same intersection. In the intersection, the front of V1 impacted the front of V2.

Vehicle one (V1) was southbound in lane three of a divided, seven-lane, straight downhill bituminous wet roadway intending to cross through a traffic controlled intersection. V2 was eastbound in lane four, intending to turn left at the same intersection. The front of V1 impacted the left side of V2. V1 came to rest facing southeast close to the point of impact with V2. V2 came to rest facing northeast close to the point of impact. Both vehicles were towed due to damage.

V1 was westbound in lane 3 on a state highway negotiating a right curve. V2 was eastbound in lane 2 on the same state highway negotiating a left curve. V1 traveled off the left side of the road into the center depressed grass median. V1 crossed the median. It became airborne and started to roll to the right as it entered the eastbound lanes. V1's front struck the top of V2. V1 rolled three more quarter turns to the right and came to rest on its wheels between eastbound lanes 1 and 2 facing southeast. During the rollover, the driver was completely ejected. According to the police report, he came to rest in eastbound lane 3. After the impact with V1, V2 traveled off the left side of the road, impacted a ditch with its front plane, and came to rest in the center depressed grass median facing southeast.

V1 exited the parking lot and headed east in lane one. V1 was towing a trailer. V2 was traveling eastbound in lane four intending to go straight. V1 traveled a short distance in lane one and attempted to make a u-turn across all eastbound travel lanes. The front of V2 contacted the left side of V1. V1 continued to travel a short distance and the left side of V1's trailer contacted the right side of V2. V1 came to final rest near the point of impact with V2 facing northwest. After the impact with V1, V2 came to final rest near the point of impact with V1 in lane four of eastbound travel facing northwest.

Vehicle One (V1) was attempting to turn left at a four-way traffic controlled intersection. Vehicle Two (V2) was attempting to cross over the same intersection. The front of V2 impacted the right side of V1.

Vehicle one (V1) was exiting a parking lot on a two-lane, undivided, level roadway. V2 was westbound in lane one of this roadway, negotiating a right curve. As V1 turned left, the left side was struck by the front of V2. V1 rotated CCW and came to final rest in lane one of eastbound travel facing east. V2 rotated CCW and came to final rest in lane one of westbound travel facing southwest.

V1 was eastbound in lane 2 on a 5-lane suburban street. V2 was westbound on the same street in lane 2. V1 crossed the two-way center left turn lane and entered the westbound lanes. The front of V1 contacted the front of V2.
V1 was in lane three of a divided bituminous roadway, stopped for traffic. V2 was in lane three stopped for traffic in front of V1. V1 accelerated and the front struck the back of V2.

Vehicle one (V1) was eastbound in lane two of a three-lane, straight roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was traveling northbound in lane one of three on an intersecting, divided, straight roadway. As V1 turned left in the intersection, the left side was struck by the front of V2.

V1 was westbound in lane three of four on a divided roadway crossing over an intersection. V2 was southbound in lane one of a two-lane, undivided roadway, crossing over the same intersection. The front of V2 struck the right side of V1.
V1 was traveling eastbound in lane three intending to go straight. V2 was traveling eastbound in lane three, slowing down for traffic. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2.

V1 exited the right side of the roadway and re-entered the roadway. V1 crossed over both southbound travel lanes and the painted median and entered the northbound travel lane. The front of V1 contacted the front of V2. After the impact with V1, V2 was forced south. The rear of V2 contacted the guardrail. V1 and V2 were towed from the scene due to severe front-end damage. The driver of V1 was hospitalized with brain injury. The driver of V2 was fatal at the scene with unspecified head injury.

V1 started to rotate across the roadway and traveled into the depressed grass median. V1 entered the westbound lanes and the left side was struck by the front of V2. After impact, V1 rotated off the left side of the westbound lanes and came to rest in the median. After impact, V2 rotated and came to rest in westbound lane three.

Vehicle one (V1) was eastbound on a divided, straight, downhill, bituminous roadway approaching an intersection. V2 was westbound in lane four of the same roadway approaching the same intersection. V1 turned left in the intersection and the front of V1 struck the front of V2.

V1 was southbound in lane 1 on a state highway approaching an intersection. V2 was northbound in lane 4 on the same state highway approaching the same intersection. V1 entered the intersection intending to go straight. V2 entered the intersection intending to turn left. The front of V1 contacted the right side of V2.

V1 was stopped in traffic at a red light in southbound lane 3 on a suburban street. V2 was also stopped at the same traffic light in southbound lane 3 in front of V1. V1 rolled forward. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2. Both vehicles came to rest near the point of impact facing south in southbound lane 3.

Vehicle one (V1) was southbound in lane three of four on a divided, six-lane, straight, level, dry roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was southbound, stopped in lane two of the same roadway. V1 changed lanes into lane two and the front struck the back of V2. V1 came to rest facing south in the intersection. V2 came to rest facing south in lane one, south of the intersection.

V1 was traveling eastbound intending to go straight. V2 was traveling westbound intending to turn left at the intersection. The front of V1 contacted the front of V2. V1 rotated clockwise while V2 rotated counterclockwise and the left side of V1 contacted the right side of V2.

Vehicle one, a pick-up truck, was southbound in lane three of a divided, eight-lane, concrete state highway, crossing over a traffic controlled intersection. V2, an SUV, was northbound in lane four of the same state highway intending to turn left at the same intersection as V1. The front of V1 impacted the right side of V2. V2 then rolled two, one-quarter turns.

V1 was westbound on an undivided, 2-lane, straight, country road. V2 was stopped in the westbound lane in front of V1 on the same road. V1 crested the hill. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2. Both vehicles came to rest in the westbound lane facing west near the point of impact.

V1 was traveling westbound in lane two intending to turn left at a 3-way intersection. V2 was traveling northbound in lane three intending to go straight through the intersection. The front of V1 struck the front of V2.
V1 was southbound in lane two of two on a divided, right curved, bituminous roadway. V2 was southbound in the same lane. The front of V1 struck the back of V2.
V2 was stopped in traffic. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2. Both vehicles came to rest near the point of impact facing west.

Vehicle one (V1) was westbound on a two-lane, undivided, private driveway. V2 was northbound in lane one on a three-lane, undivided, left-curved, state roadway. V1 entered the roadway, turning left. As V1 turned across northbound lane 2, the front of V2 struck the left side of V1. V1 yawed CW, V2 yawed CCW and the left side of V1 struck the right side of V2.

V1 was eastbound in lane one of a physically divided highway. V2 was stopped on the right-hand paved shoulder of the same highway. V1 crossed onto the shoulder and impacted the back of V2 with its front.
V1 entered the intersection intending to turn right. V1 stopped partially blocking the southbound right through lane. The front of V2 contacted the left side of V1.

Vehicle 1 was eastbound in lane one. Vehicle 2 was in front of V1 in the same lane, slowing for a deer that had entered the roadway. The front of V1 impacted the rear of V2. Both vehicles came to rest facing east in lane one close to the point of impact.

V1 and V2 were traveling eastbound in lane three of a three-lane, divided, level interstate highway. V2 was stopped in the traffic lane. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2. Both vehicles came to rest near the point of impact on their wheels facing east.

Vehicle one (V1) was eastbound in lane two of an undivided, seven-lane, straight, level, bituminous roadway approaching a traffic controlled intersection. V2 was eastbound in the same lane, decelerating while approaching the intersection. The front of V1 impacted the rear of V2.

V1 and V2 were eastbound in lane three of a seven-lane roadway. V2 was in front of V1 and was stopped at an intersection. The front of V1 struck the back of V2. Both vehicles came to rest in lane three near the point of impact facing east.

V1 was westbound in lane 4 on a street approaching an intersection. V2 was eastbound in lane 2 approaching the same intersection. V1 entered the intersection intending to turn left. V2 entered the intersection intending to go straight. The front of V2 contacted the right side of V1.

V1 was northbound in lane 4 on a state highway approaching an interchange. V2 was southbound in lane 1 on the same highway approaching the same interchange. V1 intended to turn left, V2 intended to go straight. The front of V2 contacted the right side of V1.

Vehicle one (V1) was traveling westbound in lane three of a four-lane, undivided, straight roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was traveling eastbound in lane one of the same roadway. As V1 turned left at the intersection, the front struck the front of V2. Both vehicles came to rest in the intersection and were towed.

Vehicle one (V1) was westbound in lane three on a straight, level roadway, approaching an intersection. V2 was eastbound in lane two on the same roadway, approaching the same intersection. As V1 turned left at the intersection, the front struck the front of V2.

V1 was traveling westbound in lane five of an eight-lane, divided, level, straight roadway approaching a four-way traffic controlled intersection intending to turn left. V2 was traveling eastbound in lane two of the same roadway approaching the intersection intending to go straight. The front of V2 contacted the right side of V1. V1 rotated clockwise and came to final rest in the intersection facing northeast. After the impact with V1, V2 rotated clockwise and came to rest in the intersection facing southwest.

V1 was eastbound in lane three approaching an intersection. V2, was westbound in lane 3 approaching the same intersection. V1 entered the intersection intending to turn left. V2 entered the intersection intending to go straight. The front of V1 contacted the front of V2.

V1 was traveling westbound in lane one of a four-lane, divided, level, straight, federal highway. V2 was traveling westbound in lane one directly in front of V1. V2 slowed for traffic and the front of V1 contacted the back of V2.

Vehicle one (V1) was northbound in lane two of a divided four-lane road. V2 was also northbound in the same lane stopped for traffic. The front of V1 impacted the back of V2. Both vehicles came to rest facing northbound in lane two, close to the point of impact.

V1 was traveling on a 2 lane, 2 way, asphalt roadway intending on turn left. V2 was traveling on a 2 lane, 2 way, asphalt roadway intending on going straight. The front of V1 contacted the right side of V2 causing damage to both vehicles. The vehicles came to rest in the intersection.

V1 was traveling south and turning left while V2 was traveling west. As V1 turned left the front of V2 contacted the left of V1. V1 spun counter-clockwise and came to rest while V2 rotated counter-clockwise until it rolled over on its roof and came to rest.
V1 veered left crossing all south and northbound travel lanes. The right side of V1 came into contact with the front of V2 which tore the front end from the frame of V1.

V1 was heading south and turning east from a 4 lane roadway while V2 was heading north on the same roadway. As V1 turned left, V2 steered right and the 2 vehicles contacted front to front. V1 was rotated counterclockwise from the impact and came to rest in the oncoming inside lane while north of the intersection. V2 veered right and went slightly off road to contact a pole.

V1 was traveling westbound on a roadway. V2 was traveling northbound on another roadway. V1 stopped for the traffic light and then proceeded through the intersection contacting V2. V2 continued through the intersection after the initial impact and off the road before coming in contact with a tree. V2 came to rest to the right of the tree. V1 came to rest in the intersection.

V1 was heading south while V2 was heading north on the same roadway. As the vehicles approached each other, V1 lost control and began a counter-clockwise spin as it approached the centerline. As V1 crossed the centerline, the front of V2 contacted the right of V1.

V1 was traveling south on a 3 lane, 2 way driveway attempting to turn left. V2 was traveling west on a 3 lane, 2 way roadway intending on going straight. As V1 started to make his turn the left side was contacted by the front of V2.

V1 was traveling on a 2 lane, 2 way roadway. V2 was traveling on a 2 lane, 2 way roadway approaching an intersection. V1 approached an intersection and stopped at a stop sign and then began to turn left. The driver of V1 saw V2 and stopped in the travel lane at which time the left front fender was contacted by the front of V2. Both vehicles stopped where the impact occurred coming to final rest in the intersection.

Vehicle 1 was stopped at an intersection. Vehicle 1 started to pass through the intersection and was contacted on the right side by the front of Vehicle 2. Both vehicles traveled off road to the northwest where the left rear wheel of Vehicle 1 contacted the curb and the left back panel contacted a post before coming to rest. Vehicle 2 also left the roadway and rolled over coming to rest on its left side.

V 1 was traveling north on a 2 lane, 2 way, asphalt roadway. V 2 was stopped in the southbound left turn lane behind a non-contact vehicle which intended to turn left onto an expressway entrance ramp. The non-contact vehicle began to turn left across the path of V 1. V 1 steered left and applied the brakes to avoid a collision and entered the southbound lane. The front of V 1 contacted the front of V 2.
V1 and V2 were headed west and east respectively, intending to turn left and continue straight, on a 5 lane asphalt roadway. As V1 began a left turn, the front of V2 contacted the front of V1.

V1 was headed west on a 5 lane asphalt roadway. V2 was headed north on a 5 lane asphalt roadway. As both vehicles entered the intersection, the front of V1 contacted the right door of V2. V2 then spun approx. 80 degrees as it headed for the northwest curb.

Vehicle 1 was traveling west, intending to turn left onto a 2 lane, 2 way roadway. Vehicle 2 was traveling northbound while negotiating a left curving roadway. Vehicle 1 began to turn left, and was contacted on its left side by the front of vehicle 2.

V1 was headed north and then turned sharply right heading north east on a 2 lane, asphalt roadway. V2 was headed southwest on the same road as V1. As V1 slid on the slippery road it began a counterclockwise rotation and as it crossed the centerline the front of V2 contacted the right front of V1. V1 continued rotating as its right contacted the Left of V2.

V1 was traveling south on a 2 lane asphalt roadway. V2 was traveling north on the same roadway. As V1 began to drift across the centerline, the left front of V1 contacted the left front of V2. Both vehicles spun slightly counterclockwise to final rest on the roadway.
V1 stopped behind V2. The vehicles started to move forward. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2.

Vehicle 1 was traveling westbound in the 2nd lane of a 5 lane, dry asphalt roadway. Vehicle 2 was turning left from a driveway intending to travel eastbound on the same roadway as V1. The front of V2 contacted the right side of V1. No other incident occurred.

V1 was delivering newspapers and was driving on the north shoulder of the road. The vehicle started to lose control in the slush and started to rotate in a counterclockwise rotation. The vehicle entered the roadway and crossed over the centerline, facing south, where the right side was contacted by the front of V2. After this initial impact, V1 then rotated in a clockwise rotation and the right front of the vehicle contacted the right side of V2. V1 then came to final rest in the ditch on the south side near a pine tree. V2 came to final rest in the east bound travel lane.

V1 was traveling south on a 2-lane, 2-way roadway. V2 was traveling north. As the vehicles approached each other, V2 started to lose control, spun in a counter clockwise rotation, and crossed over the centerline. When V2 crossed into the southbound lanes, the right front was struck by the front of V1. Both vehicles rotated in opposite directions and the left rear of V1 contacted the right rear of V2. The vehicles then came to final rest.

V1 was traveling northbound on a 2 lane asphalt roadway. V2 was traveling eastbound on a 5 lane two-way asphalt roadway. V1 was approaching an intersection intending to turn right, contacting the front to the right side of V2, and then side slapping its left side to the right side of V2.
V1 was headed east on a 3 lane roadway while V2 was stopped ahead of V1 in the same lane waiting for a traffic signal at an intersection. The front of V1 contacted the rear of V2.

V1 was traveling southbound on a 5 lane, not divided, dry asphalt roadway that is regulated by a traffic signal. V2 was traveling northbound on a similar roadway. Approaching the intersection, V1 began to turn left, and the right side of V1 contacted the front of V2.

V1 was traveling eastbound approaching an intersection while in the left turn lane. V2 was traveling westbound. V1 entered the intersection turning left and contacted the front of V2 with its right side. Both vehicles veered counterclockwise contacting the left side of V2 to the right side of V1. As the vehicles separated, the left back bumper of V2 contacted the right side of V1.

V1 was traveling west in the 3rd lane of a 6 lane, 2 way roadway intending to go straight through the intersection. V2 was traveling south in the 2nd lane of a 4 lane divided driveway intending on turning left. As the vehicles entered the intersection the front of V1 contacted the left side of V2 causing V2 to rotate clockwise slightly before coming to rest in the intersection. V1 came to final rest just ahead on the initial impact area.

V1 was traveling south. V2 was traveling north and turning left. As both vehicles entered the intersection the front of V1 contacted the front of V2. Both vehicles were towed from the scene. Both vehicles experienced dual frontal airbag deployment. All occupants of both vehicles were transported for medical attention.
Vehicle 2 crossed over the center lane line contacting it's front to the front of V1.

V1 was traveling east on a 3 lane, 1 way roadway. V2 was traveling north in the 2nd lane of a 3 lane, 1 way expressway exit ramp. As the vehicles entered the intersection the front of V2 contacted the right side of V1 causing V1 to rollover onto its left side before coming to rest in the north east section of the intersection. V2 came to rest on the north side of the intersection in the 1st lane.

V1 was traveling south in the 1st lane of a 5 lane, 2 way, roadway. V2 was stopped in the lane that V1 was traveling. The front of her vehicle contacted the back of V2. V1 was towed from the scene. The driver of V1 was transported to a local trauma center where she was treated for a serious upper arm fracture and released.

Vehicle 1 was traveling southbound in the 2nd lane of a 4 lane expressway. Vehicle 2, a semi tractor with trailer, was traveling southbound in the 1st lane. Vehicle 1 began to lose control in the slush, contacting its front to the left side of vehicle 2 and then the right side of the pickup bed to the left side of vehicle 2. Vehicle 1 spun counterclockwise, crossed back into lane 2, 3 and 4 before coming to final rest at a barrier.

V1 was traveling north on a roadway that curves to the right. V2 was traveling south on the same roadway. As V1 came through the curve it crossed over the center line and the front of the vehicle contacted the left side of V2.

V1 was going south intending to turn left from a 2 lane roadway. V2 was headed east on a 2 lane roadway. V1 went around a non contact vehicle and attempted a left turn when the front of V2 contacted the left front of V1 causing V1 to spin counter-clockwise until the left rear of V1 contacted the right of V2. Both vehicles came to rest east of the intersection in the roadway.

V1 was headed east from a driveway intending to cross to another drive on the east side of the road. V2 was headed north in lane 2 of a roadway. In the intersection the front of V2 contacted the right of V1.

V1 was traveling south attempting to turn east out of a driveway. V2 was traveling west in a 2-way left turn lane. V1 was waved through by two stopped vehicles and proceeded to cross over the lanes before making a left turn. When V1 pulled out, the front of V1 contacted the front of V2. V1 rotated clockwise before coming to rest. V2 came to rest in the lane just ahead of the crash.
V1 was headed west on a roadway. V2 was heading east on the same roadway. As V1 crossed the center line the front of V1 contacted the front of V2.

V1 was traveling south in the northbound lanes of a 3 lane, 1 way expressway. V2 was traveling north in the 3rd lane of the same roadway as V1. The front of V1 contacted the front of V2 causing severe damage to both vehicles.

Vehicle 1 was traveling northbound on a 2 lane, 2 way, concrete roadway. Vehicle 2 was traveling southbound on the same roadway. Vehicle 1's right tire went off the right lane line and onto the gravel shoulder. The driver of vehicle 1 attempted to steer left to bring the vehicle back into the travel lane when it reentered the roadway and crossed over the center line. The front of vehicle 1 contacted the front of vehicle 2. Vehicle 1 continued across an intersection leaving the roadway and striking the front and right side to a brick decorative wall outside of a subdivision. Vehicle 2 came to final rest at the point of impact in the same travel lane as it had been traveling prior to the crash.

As both vehicles entered the intersection, the front of V2 contacted the right of V1. Both vehicles rotated after the initial impact as the right of V1 contacted the left of V2 in a side slap configuration.

V1 was traveling east on a 3 lane, 2 way, asphalt roadway, intending to continue straight through the intersection. V2 was traveling south in the 1st lane of a 3 lane, 2 way, asphalt roadway and was also intending to continue straight through the intersection. As the vehicles entered the intersection the front of V2 contacted the left side of V1 causing both vehicles to go across the intersection and come to rest in the southeast corner of the intersection.

V1 was traveling south in the 3rd lane of a 4-lane, 1-way roadway. V2 was traveling east in the 4th lane of a 4-lane, 1-way roadway. As the vehicles entered a signal-regulated intersection, the front of V2 contacted the right side of V1, causing both vehicles to rotate, and the right side of V1 contacted the left side of V2.
Vehicle 2 stopped in the 2nd traffic lane with the intending to turn left. The front of Vehicle 1 contacted the back of Vehicle 2.

V1 was traveling west in the 2nd lane of a 5 lane, 2 way, concrete roadway that is divided by a concrete raised barrier. V2 was in the same lane as V1 and just started up in traffic as the light had just turned green. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2 causing damage to both vehicles.

Vehicle 1 was traveling on a 4 lane, 2 way roadway. Vehicle 2 was traveling on the same roadway approaching a 4 legged intersection. Vehicle 2 crossed into the intersection where the front of V1 contacted the front of V2 as V1 pulled into the 2nd lane of traffic which flows in the opposite direction. Vehicle 2 came to rest in the intersection. Vehicle 1 crossed the intersection and came to rest at the northwest corner.

V1 was traveling west on a 2 lane, dry, asphalt roadway. V2 was traveling south on a 2 lane, dry, asphalt roadway. As both vehicles entered the same intersection the front of V1 contacted the left rear of V2. Both vehicles came to rest near the southwest curb apex.

Vehicle 1 was traveling west on a 2 lane, 2 way roadway approaching an intersection with lighted controls. Vehicle 2 was traveling south in the 2nd lane of a 4 lane, 2 way roadway. Vehicle 1 entered the intersection and the right side contacted the front of vehicle 2.
V1 was traveling on a roadway approaching an intersection. V2 was stopped at the intersection waiting for the light to change. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2 causing damage to V2.

V1 was headed north on a 2 lane, dry, asphalt road. V2 was headed west on a 2 lane, dry, asphalt road. In the intersection, the front of V2 contacted the right of V1. Both vehicles rotated CW. Then V1 rolled to the left 4 quarter turns and landed on its wheels off road to the left. V2 came to rest in the roadway near the northwest curb. Both vehicles were towed.
V1 was heading west on a 2 lane, intersecting roadway. V2 was heading south on a 2 lane, intersecting roadway. In the intersection, the front of V2 contacted the left of V1.
V1 was traveling north on a 2 lane, 1 way expressway. V2 was traveling in the same direction as V1. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2.

V1 was headed west on a 2 lane, wet, asphalt roadway. V2 was headed north in lane 2 of a 4 lane, wet, asphalt roadway. In the intersection, the front of V2 contacted the left of V1. The vehicles then rotated and a secondary side slap impact occurred with the right of V2 contacting the left back of V1. Both vehicles came to rest in the intersection.

Vehicle 1 was traveling southbound on a roadway, approaching an intersection. Vehicle 2 was traveling eastbound, crossing through an intersection. Vehicle 2 entered the intersection to continue straight through when the front of V1 contacted the left side of V2. Both vehicles came to final rest at the southeast corner of the roadway without further incident. Both vehicles were towed from the scene of the crash. Both drivers were transported to a local trauma facility for treatment of moderate injuries.

V1 was traveling east in the 2nd lane of a 4 lane, 2-way, asphalt roadway. V2 was also traveling east in the same lane. V2 slowed down to attempt a left hand turn into a gas station parking lot when the front of V1 contacted the back of V2.
Vehicles 1 and 2 were headed east and turning left from a 3 lane, one way, concrete expressway exit ramp. As both vehicles began to turn the left of V2 contacted the right of V1.

Vehicle 2 was traveling west in the first lane of a 5 lane roadway with a center 2 way, left turn lane preparing to turn right into a subdivision. Vehicle 1 was traveling in the same lane as vehicle 2 at a higher speed. The front of V1 contacted the back of V2. V1 and V2 came to final rest in the same lane.

Vehicle 2 was traveling northbound in the far left lane on an expressway. Vehicle 1 was traveling on an entrance ramp to an expressway with a stop sign at the end of the ramp. Vehicle 1 entered the roadway from the ramp by crossing into the far left lane where the front of vehicle 2 contacted the back of vehicle 1.
V1 was headed north and turning left from a 2 lane roadway while V2 was headed east on a 4 lane roadway. In the intersection, the front of V2 contacted the left of V1.

V1 was traveling east on a 2-lane, 2-way asphalt roadway. V2 was traveling north on a 2-lane, 2-way asphalt roadway. As the vehicles entered the intersection the front of V2 contacted the right side of V1. This impact caused both vehicles to rotate clockwise and the front of V2 contacted the right front of V1 again. V1 continued its clockwise rotation and went off the road on the northeast corner on the intersection and the right rear of the vehicle contacted a stop sign before coming to rest in the ditch facing westbound. V2 rotated about 90 degrees and it went off of the road on the northeast corner of the intersection and began to rollover. The vehicle rolled over 6 quarter turns before coming to rest on its roof.

Vehicle 1 was headed west and turning left from a 3 lane asphalt roadway. V2 was headed east on the same roadway. As the 2 vehicles met in the intersection the front of V1 contacted the front of V2. V1 rotated counterclockwise as it was pushed backward while V2 continued in an eastern direction until both vehicles came to rest in the intersection.
V1 was headed north on a 2 lane, asphalt roadway. V2 was in the same lane and stopped at a traffic light. V1 contacted the rear of V2.

V1 was traveling in a 4 lane, 2 way roadway attempting a left hand turn at the intersection. V2 was traveling in the same roadway as V1 and intending on going straight through the intersection. As the vehicles entered the intersection the front of V1 contacted the front of V2 causing both vehicles to rotate. As the vehicles were rotating the right side of V1 contacted the left side of V2.

V1 was traveling west on a roadway. At the intersection, V1 was intending to go straight. V2 was traveling north on another roadway. V2 was also intending to go straight through the intersection. As the vehicles entered the intersection, the front of V1 contacted the right side of V2.

Vehicle 1 was traveling east in the 2nd lane of a 4 lane, 2 way, and dry concrete roadway. Vehicle 2 was traveling in the same direction behind vehicle 1. Vehicle 1 approached an intersection and turned left while vehicle 2 changed lanes to the left into oncoming traffic contacting the front bumper to the left side of vehicle 1. Vehicle 2 came to final rest in both westbound travel lanes at an angle. Vehicle 1 came to rest in the intersection approximately 30 meters from its intended destination.

Vehicle 1 was traveling northbound in the second lane. Vehicle 2 was traveling southbound in the second lane. The right side of vehicle 1 came in contact with the front of vehicle 2. Vehicle 2 came to rest in its original travel lane. Vehicle 1 continued across the southbound travel lanes and came to rest.
V1 and V2 were both headed south on a 5 lane, dry, asphalt roadway. V1 was in lane 2 and V2 was half in lane 2 and half in lane 3. The front left of V1 contacted the rear of V2.
V1 was traveling north on a 2-lane, 2-way roadway that curves to the right. V2 was traveling south on the same roadway as V1. The front of V1 contacted the front of V2.

V1 was traveling west. At the intersection V1 was intending on turning left. V2 was traveling north. V2 was intending on going straight through the intersection. As the vehicles entered the intersection the front of V2 contacted the left side of V1 causing V1 to rotate counter clockwise 180 degrees. During the rotation the left front of V1 contacted the left rear of V2.

V1 was traveling in lane two of a two-way roadway. V2 was traveling in lane two of a two-way roadway. The front of V1 contacted the left side of V2. After initial impact, the right side of V1 impacted the rear of V2 prior to final rest.

Vehicle 1 was traveling southbound on a 2 lane, 2 way, asphalt roadway. Vehicle 2 was traveling westbound. Both vehicles were approaching a 4 leg intersection with a stop sign at the southbound and northbound legs. Upon entering the intersection, the front of vehicle 2 contacted the left side of vehicle 1. The right side of vehicle 2 then contacted the left side of vehicle 1 in a sideslap manner. Vehicle 1 came to rest in the intersection. Vehicle 2 continued forward to the southwest corner of the intersection contacting a utility pole with the front bumper.

V1 was traveling east on a two-lane, two-way roadway attempting to turn left into a driveway. V2 was traveling west on the same roadway as V1 intending on going straight. As V1 attempted to make the left turn, the right side was contacted by the front of V2.

V1 was headed north in lane 3 intending to turning left from a 5 lane, 2 way asphalt roadway. V2 was headed southeast intending to continue straight in lane 2 of 5 lane, 2 way dry asphalt roadway. V2's path was on a roadway that was at a 55 degree angle to the roadway that V1 was traveling. As V1 began an evasive move steering slightly right in an attempt to avoid the crash, the front of V2 contacted the left of V1 in the intersection. V1 rotated clockwise as the front of V2 contacted the left rear of V1 prior to final rest for both vehicles in the confines of the intersection.
V1 was heading west in lane 2 of a 5 lane, 2 way asphalt roadway. V2 was headed east and turning left from the same roadway. As V2 turned left the front of V1 contacted the front-right of V2.

V1 was traveling northbound on a two-way, four-lane roadway approaching a T-intersection. V2 was traveling southbound on the same roadway approaching the same intersection as V1. A non-contact vehicle had been traveling north in front of V1 and stopped at the intersection waiting to turn left. V1 changed lanes into the right lane to pass this other vehicle. V1's right front tire went off the roadway during the lane change while passing the stopped vehicle. The driver of V1 hit the brakes and steered to the left to pull the vehicle back onto the roadway, causing the vehicle to rotate counterclockwise. V1 then yawed into the southbound, inside travel lane occupied by V2. The right side of V1 contacted the front of V2. V1 traveled off road onto the west roadside. V2 stayed on the roadway and came to final rest in the right turn lane.

V1 was traveling west in the 2nd lane of a 4 lane, 2 way roadway. V2 was traveling east in the 2nd lane on the same roadway. V1 crossed into the east bound travel lane and the front of V1 contacted the front of V2. The impact caused V1 to spin in a clockwise rotation and depart the road on the south side facing an easterly direction. V2 also spun in a clockwise rotation and came to rest in the 2nd lane of the westbound travel lanes facing west.

V1 was traveling north in the 2nd lane of a 3 lane, 2 way roadway. V2 was traveling west on a 3 lane, 2 way roadway. Both vehicles were approaching a four legged intersection and intending to continue straight. As the vehicles entered the intersection the front of V2 contacted the right side of V1. After initial impact V2 went off of the road on the north west corner of the intersection before coming to rest. V1 spun counter clockwise in the intersection and came to rest there.

V1 was traveling south in the 1st lane of a 4 lane, 2 way roadway. At the intersection v1 was intending on going straight. V2 was traveling north in the 2nd lane on the same roadway as v1, intending to turn left at the intersection. When v2 started her turn the right side was contacted by the front of v1 which caused v2 to rollover onto its left side.
V1 was headed west and turning left while V2 was headed east. As V1 turned left, both vehicles met in the intersection with the front of V2 contacting the right front of V1.

Vehicle 1 was traveling south on a 4 lane, 2 way, asphalt roadway. Vehicle 2 was traveling east on a 2 lane, 2 way, asphalt roadway. Both vehicles were approaching an intersection, the front of vehicle 1 contacted the left side of vehicle 2. After the initial impact, vehicle 1 spun slightly counterclockwise and vehicle 2 spun slightly clockwise to sideslap the right of vehicle 1 to the left of vehicle 2.

V1 was east bound, pulling out a 2 lane driveway intending on turning left. V2 was traveling south in the 1st lane of a 5 lane roadway intending on going straight. As V1 pulled out from the driveway the left side was contacted by the front of V2, causing moderate damage to both vehicles.
V1 was turning left on a roadway. V2 was headed east on a roadway. In the intersection, the front of V2 contacted the left front of V1.

Vehicle 1 was traveling southbound in the first lane of a 4 lane, 2 way, asphalt roadway. Vehicle 2 was traveling northbound in the second lane of the same roadway. Vehicle 2 attempted to turn left. The front of vehicle 1 contacted the right side of vehicle 2.

V1 was traveling west in the 2nd lane of a 3 lane, 2 way roadway, approaching an intersection with a four way stop. V1 was intending to continue through the intersection. V2 was traveling north in the 2nd lane of a 3 lane, 2 way roadway and approaching the same intersection intending to continue straight. As the vehicles entered the intersection the front of V1 contacted the right side of V2 causing both vehicles to rotate clockwise and impact a second time V1 right side to V2 right side. The vehicles then went off of the road on the northwest corner of the intersection where they both came to final rest.

V1 was headed north on a 2 lane, asphalt roadway and intending on going straight through the intersection. V2 was headed west on a 2 lane, asphalt roadway and intending on going straight through the intersection. As both vehicles entered the intersection the front of V1 contacted the left front door of V2.

V1 was traveling on a roadway approaching an intersection. V2 was traveling on a roadway approaching the same intersection. Both vehicles intended to go straight through the intersection. As the vehicles entered the intersection the front of V1 contacted the right side of V2 causing both vehicles to rotate and impact a second time V1 left to V2 right side. V2 then went off the road on the south east corner of the intersection and rolled over before coming to rest in the bottom of a ditch.
V2 was decelerating in the lane ahead of V1. V2 was slowing to allow the vehicle ahead of it to turn left while it was V1's intention to continue straight. The front of V1 contacted the rear of V2.

Vehicle 1 was traveling westbound in the 2nd lane. Vehicle 2 was traveling eastbound in the 2nd lane. Vehicle 1 crossed into the path of vehicle 2 and the front of vehicle 1 contacted the right side of vehicle 2.

Vehicle 1 was traveling south approaching an intersection. Vehicle 2 was traveling north. Both vehicles were approaching a 4 leg intersection with traffic lights. Driver 2 was under a blinking red light in the left turn lane beginning to turn, when vehicle 1 in the 2nd travel lane passing through the intersection, contacted it's front to the right side of vehicle 2. They stopped in the intersection coming to final rest.

V1 was traveling west intending on turning left at the intersection. V2 was traveling east intending on going straight. As V1 was making the left turn, the front contacted the left side of V2 causing V2 to go off roadway.

V1 and V2 were both headed south in lane 2 of a 4 lane roadway. V2 had stopped with the intention of turning left while V1 was traveling behind V2 with the intention of continuing straight. The front of V1 contacted the rear of V2 in the original travel lane 2.

V1 was traveling in the 2nd lane of a 5 lane, 2 way, asphalt roadway intending on going straight through an intersection. V2 was traveling in the 3rd lane of a 6 lane, 2 way, asphalt roadway and was also intending on going straight through the intersection. As the vehicles entered the intersection the front of V2 contacted the left side of V1 causing moderate damage to both vehicles.
Vehicle 1 was traveling, intending to turn left. Vehicle 2 was traveling south and was contacted by vehicle 1.

Vehicle 1 was traveling northbound in the 2nd lane of a 5 lane, 2 way, asphalt roadway. Vehicle 2 was traveling southbound in the 1st lane of the same roadway. Vehicle 1 crossed into the oncoming travel lanes. Vehicle 2 attempted to avoid the collision by swerving to the right lane. The front of vehicle 1 contacted the front of vehicle 2.

V1 was headed east intending to turn left while V2 was headed west intending on continuing straight. As V1 began the turn the front of V2 contacted the right of V1 causing V1 to rotate counterclockwise.

V1 was traveling north on an expressway exit ramp approaching an intersection and intending on going straight. V2 was traveling west on a roadway approaching the same intersection as V1 and also intending on going straight. As the vehicles entered the intersection, the front of V2 contacted the right side of V1. The vehicles came to rest in the intersection.
V1 and V2 were traveling north in the 2nd lane. V2 was slowing down because the traffic light had turned yellow. As V2 was slowing down, the front of V1 contacted the back of V2.
V1 was negotiating the curve through the intersection. V2 was headed north and intending to turn left. As V2 turned the front of V1 contacted the right of V2.
As the two vehicles met in the curved signal regulated intersection the front of V2 contacted the right of V1.

V1 was headed east in lane 2 of a 5 lane concrete roadway. V2 was headed west in lane 2 of the same 5 lane concrete roadway. As V1 headed into lane 3 and crossed the center line into lane 2 of oncoming traffic, the front of V1 contacted the front of V2.

V1 was traveling west in the 1st lane of a divided roadway. At the intersection, V1 was intending on going straight. V2 was traveling south in the 2nd lane of an exit ramp, intending on making a left hand turn at the intersection. As the vehicles entered the intersection, the front of V1 contacted the left side of V2, causing V1 to veer left, travel over a raised median and come to rest on the south side of the road. V2 spun in a clockwise rotation before leaving the road on the north side, where it came to rest on a guy wire.
V1 was traveling south and turning left from lane 2 of a 4 lane roadway. V2 was traveling north in lane 2 of the same roadway. As V1 turned left the front of V2 contacted the right of V1.

V1 and V2 were traveling east in the 1st lane of a 4 lane, 2 way roadway. V2 had ran out of gas and was stopped in the traffic lane when the front of V1 contacted the back of V2. V2 then went off of the road on the south east corner of the intersection where it came to rest, half on the road and half on the lawn. V1 continued to travel east before coming to final rest just east of the intersection.

Vehicle 1 and 2 were traveling on a 5 lane, 2 way, asphalt roadway which was under construction. There were orange barrels in the right curb lane, and a moveable concrete wall to the left. Vehicle 2 stopped for traffic and the driver of vehicle 1 applied the brakes however, the front of vehicle 1 contacted the back of vehicle 2. Vehicle 2 was shoved forward approximately 10 feet and came to final rest in the same lane. Vehicle 1 came to rest in the same lane as well.

V1 was traveling east and turning left at an intersection. V2 was traveling west on the same roadway intending to go straight through the intersection. As V1 turned left, the front of V2 contacted the right of V1.
V1 started to drift over into the right lane where the front contact the left side of V2.

Vehicle 1, was traveling eastbound in the 2nd lane of a 4 lane, 2 way roadway. Vehicle 1 was approaching a 4 leg intersection with a functional traffic light. Vehicle 2, was traveling northbound in the 2nd lane of a 5 lane, 2 way roadway and was approaching the same intersection. Both vehicles entered the intersection at the same time. The front of vehicle 2 contacted the right side of vehicle 1. The right side sliding door of vehicle 1 opened upon impact. Both vehicles stopped in the intersection coming to final rest.

V1 was traveling south in the left turn lane of a 5 lane, 2 way roadway and was approaching a 4 legged intersection intending to turn left. V2 was traveling north in the 2nd lane of a 5 lane, 2 way roadway and approaching the same intersection intending to continue straight. The front of V2 contacted the right side of V1 causing V1 to rotate 90 degrees clockwise and come to rest in the north east corner of the intersection.

Vehicle 1 and vehicle 2 were traveling northbound on a divided trafficway. The asphalt roadway curved left with guardrails on the east and west shoulders. Vehicle 2 was in the 2nd lane, as was vehicle 1, which came up behind vehicle 2 at a higher speed. Vehicle 1 swerved left, clipping its right front bumper to the left back bumper of vehicle 2. Vehicle 1 continued left into the 3rd travel lane and then off the left shoulder, contacting a guardrail while spinning counterclockwise. Vehicle 2 stopped on the shoulder. Vehicle 1 continued spinning and crossed back into the roadway and off the right shoulder, where control was regained, and the driver stopped the vehicle safely on the shoulder.
